title: Creative Strategist · Paid Social, KI-native (m/w/d)

Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat begleiten.

Ich bin Linus, einer der beiden Gründer und habe die Creatives für unsere Ads bisher zum großen Teil selbst gemacht. Das Marketing wächst schneller, als ich es neben allem anderen leisten kann. Deshalb suche ich die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt und mit uns ausbaut.

Was du machst

  • Daraus testbare Konzepte machen, jeweils mit klarer Hypothese und mehreren Hooks, und davon jede Woche neue an den Start bringen.

  • Creatives selbst bauen, vor allem mit KI: Statics, Animationen und Schnitte aus vorhandenem Material.

  • Drehs organisieren, mit uns Gründern, unserem Team und UGC-Creator, von Briefing und Skript bis zur Abnahme.

  • Auswerten, was läuft und daraus die nächste Runde ableiten.

  • Später dazu: unseren Newsletter und Shortform-Content für TikTok und Reels.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Woche 1: deine erste eigene Ad ist live.

  • Monat 1: Marktbeobachtung und Ideenplanung laufen über dich und jede Woche gehen neue Tests von dir raus.

  • Monat 3: du gibst deine Ads selbst frei, kennst die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich sicher und hast einen Plan, wie wir organisch auf Shortform wachsen.

Wen wir suchen

  • Du hast schon Creatives für Paid Social gebaut, die gelaufen sind und weißt, warum sie funktioniert haben. Wie groß das Budget dahinter war, ist zweitrangig.

  • Du baust selbst, statt nur zu briefen, und arbe

Als Head of Growth verantwortest du die gesamte Wachstumsmaschine in Europa: Akquise, Conversion, Kundenbindung und Expansion in neue Länder und Kanäle.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Wachstumsstrategie und ihre Kennzahlen: Neukunden, Conversion Rate, durchschnittlicher Bestellwert, Wiederkaufrate und Payback in allen europäischen Märkten

  • Du führst die Verantwortlichen für Performance Marketing, SEO, CRM und Partnerschaften, setzt ihre Ziele und gibst ihnen das Budget, um zu gewinnen

  • Du steuerst ein konsequentes Testing-Programm für Website, Checkout, Angebote und Onboarding

  • Du planst Markteintritte und Lokalisierung in neuen EU-Ländern gemeinsam mit Content, Kundenservice und Operations

  • Du baust Forecasts und Reportings, mit denen die Geschäftsleitung entscheidet, wohin der nächste Euro fließt

  • Du machst Parfum-Abfüllungen von 10ML zum selbstverständlichen Weg, einen Duft vor dem Flakonkauf zu testen

  • Mindestens 8 Jahre in Growth oder Performance Marketing im D2C-E-Commerce, bei Marktplätzen oder Konsumgütermarken, davon mindestens 3 Jahre mit Führungsverantwortung

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge beim profitablen Skalieren bezahlter und organischer Kanäle in mehreren europäischen Ländern

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads und Analysen auf SQL-Niveau

  • Fließendes Englisch; Deutsch oder eine weitere EU-Sprache ist ein großes Plus

  • Bonus: Erfahrung in Beauty, Duft, Kosmetik oder Luxus-Retail

Join a fast-growing, listed company with a purpose and inspire thousands of drivers to transition towards electric mobility! The role

Our distinctive charging canopies create an opportunity to integrate solar panels (PV) into station design. However, this comes with a cost and certain operational complexity. What you will do

  • Research national, regional and local rules on solar panels regulations impacting tenders and contacts for our European markets.

  • Make a clear distinction between green energy sourcing and on-premises solar panels requirements.

  • If time allows: research the influence that solar panels have on customers choosing to charge at Fastned locations.

Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager Meta & Google (H/F)
description:
À propos de Scento

Scento est le plus grand site de décants de parfum d'Europe. Fondée en 2024, l'entreprise a son siège à Paris, place Vendôme, et un second bureau à Berlin. Scento propose en décant plus de 1 000 parfums de créateurs et de niche, tous originaux, issus d'un portefeuille de 200 maisons : flacons de 2 ml, 5 ml et 8 ml, ainsi qu'un flacon de 30 ml pour la plupart des parfums. Le parfum décant permet de découvrir des échantillons de parfum de niche et de grandes maisons avant d'investir dans un flacon entier. Chaque parfum est un original acheté auprès de revendeurs européens agréés, et chaque flacon passe un contrôle d'entrée en 12 points sur le site certifié ISO de Scento avant d'être décanté.

Scento sert des clients dans 27 marchés européens et livre dans 26 pays de l'Union européenne. En 2026, le chiffre d'affaires annuel de Scento dépasse 30 millions d'euros, ventes en ligne et hors ligne confondues. Sur Scento.com, les ventes mensuelles de décants de septembre 2026 représentaient 3,2 fois celles de janvier 2026. Selon Scento, plus de 3 millions de décants de parfum sont vendus chaque année, soit environ un toutes les 10 secondes. En novembre 2025, Scento a annoncé un investissement de 25 millions d'euros sur trois ans dans la découverte du parfum en Europe.

Le poste

L'acquisition payante est l'un des principaux moteurs de croissance de Scento. Nous vendons des décants de parfum de créateurs et de niche à des clients répartis sur 27 marchés européens, avec des budgets mensuels importants à placer sur Meta, Google et de nouveaux canaux.

En tant que Senior Performance Marketing Manager, vous êtes responsable de la performance de ces comptes. Le succès, c'est un CAC maîtrisé, un délai de retour sur investissement qui respecte nos objectifs, et une capacité à identifier vite ce qu'il faut arrêter et ce qu'il faut amplifier.

title: Partenaire commercial indépendant (H/F)
description:
À propos de PropertyOS

PropertyOS est une solution SaaS dédiée à la digitalisation de la gestion immobilière. Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de centraliser leurs biens, leurs locataires, leurs finances, leurs documents et leurs tâches au sein d'une plateforme unique.

Nous développons une solution moderne qui répond aux enjeux de simplification, d'organisation et de suivi du patrimoine immobilier.

Pour accompagner notre développement commercial, nous souhaitons constituer un premier réseau de partenaires indépendants motivés par la technologie, l'immobilier et l'entrepreneuriat.

🚀 Votre mission

En tant que partenaire commercial indépendant, vous contribuez au développement de PropertyOS en identifiant des professionnels susceptibles d'être intéressés par notre solution.

Selon le cadre de partenariat convenu, vos missions pourront notamment comprendre :

  • Identifier des prospects : propriétaires, investisseurs immobiliers et professionnels de la gestion locative.
  • Faire connaître PropertyOS : présenter les bénéfices de la solution et partager les supports de communication mis à disposition.
  • Générer des opportunités commerciales : mettre en relation des prospects qualifiés avec PropertyOS.
  • Contribuer au développement du réseau : faire connaître la solution auprès de votre réseau professionnel.
  • Suivre vos opportunités : utiliser les outils mis à disposition pour suivre les prospects que vous avez apportés.

Les missions de mise en relation ne comprennent pas la négociation ou la conclusion de contrats au nom de PropertyOS. Toute mission commerciale plus étendue devra faire l'objet d'un cadre contractuel adapté.

💰 Une rémunération liée à vos résultats

Nous souhaitons développer un modèle de partenariat fondé sur la performance.

La rémunération sera définie contractuellement selon la nature de la mission et les résultats obtenus.

title: Robotics Diagnostics Engineer
description:
We are looking for a robotics diagnostics engineer who enjoys getting to the bottom of complex system issues. You will investigate unexpected behaviour in our autonomous drone-in-a-box system, combining log and code analysis with hands-on experiments on engineering systems and bench setups. Bridging support and engineering, you will turn field reports into clear explanations, actionable fix recommendations and practical mitigations.

Responsibilities

  • Own investigations into system issues from new bug reports through to actionable findings, working with support to capture symptoms, operating conditions and relevant logs
  • Analyze logs and source code, develop hypotheses, and reproduce and isolate failures through targeted tests on engineering systems and bench setups
  • Assess issue severity with engineering, considering safety impact, system availability, affected versions and conditions, and uncertainty; escalate critical findings promptly
  • Give engineering clear evidence, reproduction steps and recommendations for fixes, and help verify that proposed changes address the underlying issue
  • Recommend and validate workarounds and mitigations with engineering, and give support clear guidance on their use, limitations and operational implications

Qualifications

  • Experience investigating complex software failures using logs, source code and systematic root-cause analysis
  • A practical approach to reproducing intermittent issues and designing experiments on engineering systems, bench setups or simulators
  • Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain evidence, uncertainty, safety and availability impact, and recommended next steps to engineering and support
  • Curiosity, persistence and ownership when tackling unfamiliar problems
  • A degree in computer science, robotics or related field, or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Points

  • Experience

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Mechanical Engineer binnen de Life Sciences speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerp van complexe en technisch uitdagende productiefaciliteiten, laboratoria, cleanrooms en hightech onderzoeksomgevingen. Jij vertaalt klantwensen naar betrouwbare, energie-efficiënte en toekomstbestendige werktuigbouwkundige installaties van HVACsystemen en luchtbehandeling tot proceskoeling, stoom, water- en gassystemen.

In de rol van Senior Engineer neem je bovendien de volledige ontwerpverantwoordelijkheid op je en fungeer je als aanspreekpunt voor zowel klant als ontwerpteam. Vanaf de conceptfase denk je mee over technische oplossingen die voldoen aan de strengste normen binnen Life Sciences, zoals GMP-richtlijnen, biosafety eisen en hoge duurzaamheidsstandaarden. Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines in multidisciplinaire projectteams en bewaakt de kwaliteit en samenhang van het totale ontwerp.  

 

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Meedenken in de vroege ontwerp en conceptfase van projecten, zoals laboratoria, cleanrooms en productiefaciliteiten.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
description:
Heb jij diepgaande ervaring in elektrotechnische installaties en wil je bijdragen aan de meest kritische en innovatieve datacenterprojecten van dit moment? Als Senior Electrical Engineer Datacenters bij Deerns werk je aan high‑tech, schaalbare en energie‑efficiënte faciliteiten die de digitale wereld draaiend houden. Jij ontwerpt de elektrotechnische systemen die maximale betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en continuïteit waarborgen precies waar de datacentersector om vraagt. 

 

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Electrical Engineer binnen onze Datacenter-afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de engineering en de technische coördinatie van complexe elektrotechnische installaties. Denk aan middenspannings- en laagspanningsverdelers, UPS‑systemen, generatoren, noodstroomconcepten, earthing & bonding, automatisering, beveiligingssystemen, energieopwekking en power monitoring die 24/7 betrouwbaar moeten functioneren.

Je werkt intensief samen met disciplines zoals werktuigbouwkunde, bouwkunde en security en bewaakt de technische samenhang van het integrale ontwerp. Dankzij jouw senioriteit fungeer je als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, ontwerpteams en leveranciers. Je stuurt waar nodig bij, begeleidt junior en medior engineers en draagt actief bij aan kennisontwikkeling binnen het datacenterteam.

title: Teamleider en Senior Adviseur Brandveiligheid
description:
Ben jij een ervaren Adviseur Brandveiligheid die niet alleen excelleert in complexe, grootschalige projecten, maar ook graag het voortouw neemt in het aansturen, coachen en laten groeien van een team? In deze rol combineer je inhoudelijke expertise met leiderschap en speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons team Brandveiligheid.

 

De uitdaging 
Als Teamleider Brandveiligheid bij Deerns sta jij aan het roer van een groeiend team van specialisten en geef je richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling ervan. Het team bestaat momenteel uit een mix van ervaren experts en talentvolle adviseurs en bevindt zich in een fase van sterke groei. Aan jou de uitdaging om deze groei in goede banen te leiden, het team verder uit te bouwen en te versterken zowel in omvang als in kwaliteit en positionering.

Je combineert strategisch leiderschap met inhoudelijke diepgang en bent bepalend voor de kwaliteit, koers en groei van het team. Je creëert een omgeving waarin professionals excelleren, kennis wordt gedeeld en innovatie wordt gestimuleerd.

Brandveiligheid zit in ieder project. Of het nu gaat om de nieuwbouw van een ziekenhuis, een ‘state of the art’ cleanroom, de bouw van een (houten) woontoren, of de nieuwbouw, renovatie of transformatie van een (multi-tenant) kantoorcomplex. In al deze ontwerpen speelt brandveiligheid een cruciale rol.

In de rol van adviseur opereer je op senior niveau en werk je aan complexe brandveiligheidsvraagstukken binnen al onze adviesgroepen: Gezondheidszorg, Clean Technology, Vastgoed en Luchthavens. Dit zorgt voor een grote variatie aan aansprekende projecten, nationaal en internationaal.

Experience:

Any relevant experience in web or mobile development is welcome; we are open to junior, mid-level and senior candidates who demonstrate strong practical skills and a willingness to learn.

Technical Skills:

Required:

  • Experience building mobile apps with Expo / Reac

Required:

  • Strong Python, including asyncio and streaming pipelines.
  • Hands-on work with speech (STT, TTS, VAD) and LLM APIs in latency-sensitive systems.
  • Model serving on GPUs, for example with vLLM or similar, and the basics of batching and memory limits.

title: Freelance Acquisition Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads)

Nous recherchons un(e) consultant(e) freelance spécialisé(e) en acquisition payante pour intervenir sur plusieurs projets e-commerce dans la beauté, la nutrition et la santé.

Sur l'un des projets, vous définirez et déploierez une stratégie d'acquisition payante sur les réseaux sociaux pour accompagner le lancement d'un concept sur le marché américain : choix des plateformes et des formats, architecture des campagnes, audiences, premiers tests, optimisation continue.

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

Pour les fondateurs des meilleures startups européennes :

Devenir la plateforme de référence européenne de co-investissement dans le Venture Capital.

title: Co-founder / Treuhänder/in – let's build the Treuhand of 2030
description:
Build the Treuhand of 2030.

Co-founder wanted: certified fiduciary (Treuhänder/in).

We believe that by 2030 at the latest, AI agents will handle most routine work in a Treuhand. That leaves fiduciaries with the work that needs judgment: reviewing, advising clients and signing off.

We are founding that Treuhand for Swiss startups and SMEs. AI agents prepare the work, and a qualified fiduciary signs off everything that goes to clients and authorities.

Underneath runs a finance stack built for agents, with clean data, a full audit trail and connections to the systems clients already use. Long term, we aim to run our clients' whole finance function on this stack, from bookkeeping to reporting, planning and investor/board updates.

Where we stand

The company is not founded yet. We are testing the problem in interviews with founders, CFOs and fiduciaries, three startups are interested in a paid pilot, and we have built a first prototype. You would join from day one and build the company with me. We will add a technical co-founder at a later stage.

Who you would work with

I'm Jonas Baer, two-time entrepreneur and fractional CFO for Swiss startups. As a Venturelab trainer and Innosuisse expert, I work closely with Swiss founders, the clients we want to serve. Before that I was CFO and director at a startup where we grew revenue to almost CHF 10M and the team to over 40. I studied Business Informatics at UZH and bridge finance and IT (linkedin.com/in/jonas-baer).

What you would do

  • Decide which workflows we automate first, where the AI acts alone and where a fiduciary signs

  • Teach the agents Swiss practice (MWST, AHV/BVG/UVG, booking rules) and test them on real documents

  • Serve the first pilot clients yourself

  • Build and lead the operations team as we scale

You have the final say on what gets booked, filed and signed.

title: Ingénieur·e Logiciel Embarqué
description:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

Smart Impulse c'est l'histoire d'un projet de fin d'études qui se transforme en un projet entrepreneurial ambitieux et engagé !

C'est en 2011 que Charles et Henri, nos deux fondateurs, se lancent le défi de révolutionner la gestion de l'Énergie dans les bâtiments.

Plus concrètement, nous concevons et développons des solutions de mesure électrique nouvelle génération avec un compteur électrique, le Smart X, simple à installer (moins d'une heure, sans outil et sans coupure), permettant, à partir d'un seul point de mesure et d'algorithmes brevetés (Nonintrusive Load Monitoring - NILM), d'identifier la consommation de chaque type d'équipements dans un bâtiment (éclairage, chauffage, informatique, ventilation, etc.).

Créée en 2004 par Alain Marty, fondateur du Cercle Wine Business, In Vino Radio est aujourd’hui la seule émission de radio au monde entièrement consacrée à l’actualité des vins et spiritueux.

title: AI Engineer
description:
sizeless is building the data layer for the infrastructure under our streets. A construction crew films an open trench with a phone, and our system turns that recording into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and produces the documentation the industry needs - CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities - in a fraction of the time it takes today.

It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small technical team, founded out of ETH Zürich and MIT, and we are looking for engineers who want to work on frontier AI in a domain where it has barely arrived.

Tasks

  • Build and improve the agents that turn captured reality into finished documentation
  • Work on the perception and semantic layer that recognises components and structures in 3D
  • Build the evaluation and verification that tells us when the system is right - and when it is not
  • Scale the pipelines behind it: video, point clouds, large documents, and a lot of compute

Requirements

  • Solid engineering fundamentals and strong Python
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, agents and the tooling around them
  • Real leverage from AI-assisted development, whatever your setup
  • Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through
  • Full working proficiency in English; German is a plus, not a requirement

At CDDS, you'll build the software platform that connects our next-generation interceptor drones with sensors and operators, the nervous system of a counter-drone defense network protecting critical infrastructure and, ultimately, saving lives.

We're looking for a strong all-around software engineer to:

  • Build the platform that fuses radar, sensors, and third-party data into a single, real-time operational picture
  • Integrate our drones with external systems at low latency, under conditions where reliability isn't optional
  • Design fleet-management tooling to monitor, configure, and coordinate drones operating in the field

This is real-time, safety-critical software with actual physical stakes. You'll work close to hardware, close to operators, and close to the mission. We move fast and priorities shift as the threat landscape does.

Tasks

What you will own

  • Architect the ground-segment platform that fuses radar and multi-sensor data into a real-time operational picture, under latency budgets where milliseconds decide outcomes
  • Build the integration layer connecting our drones to third-party sensors and platforms, designing the plugins and data interfaces that make it work reliably in the field
  • Design and own fleet-management and provisioning tooling that commands and coordinates a live interceptor fleet
  • Profile, tune, and harden system performance so it holds up under real-world load
  • Work close to the field: see your code deployed on real hardware, in front of real customers

Requirements

title: Consultant Revenue Management H/F
description:
Spécialiste du revenue management externalisé depuis 18 ans, Xperteo accompagne des groupes hôteliers et établissements indépendants dans l’optimisation de leur performance.

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Consultant(e) Revenue Management & Distribution expérimenté(e).

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) à votre Team Leader, vous êtes responsable de la performance revenue et distribution d’un portefeuille d’hôtels.

Véritable partenaire stratégique des établissements, vous intervenez à la fois sur le pilotage opérationnel et le conseil.

Pilotage d’un portefeuille hôtels :

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie tarifaire et de distribution
  • Analyser la performance : occupation, ADR, RevPAR, pick-up, paceSuivre et optimiser les résultats au quotidien
  • Fixer les objectifs mensuels et annuels avec les clients
  • Identifier les leviers de croissance et recommander des actions concrètes

Relation client & conseil

  • Être l’interlocuteur(trice) privilégié(e) des hôtels
  • Animer des points réguliers avec les directeurs et exploitants
  • Construire une relation de confiance dans une logique de partenariat long terme
  • Garantir la satisfaction client et la reconduction des contrats

Distribution & outils

  • Piloter le channel management et la visibilité en ligne
  • Gérer et contrôler les mises à jour sur PMS, RMS, Channel Manager, OTA
  • Assurer une utilisation optimale des outils métiers

Reporting & recommandations

  • Produire des analyses régulières et des reportings stratégiques
  • Formuler des recommandations argumentées et actionnables

title: Stage - Développement commercial et sensibilisation - Filière vitivinicole (6 mois)
description:
Oenoco est une start-up basée à Reims, fondée en octobre 2023, née de la volonté d’accélérer la transition écologique de la filière vitivinicole.

Nous concevons des solutions innovantes et pédagogiques pour promouvoir le réemploi des bouteilles en verre dans le domaine du vin, un levier clé encore largement sous-exploité pour décarboner la filière.

Parmi nos initiatives, nous avons créé la fresque « De la Vigne à la Consigne » et «Consigne Quest» , deux outils de sensibilisation ludiques destinés aussi bien aux professionnels de la filière qu’au grand public. Ces serious games mettent en lumière les impacts du dérèglement climatique sur l’ensemble de la chaîne vitivinicole et soulignent l’urgence d’adopter des pratiques plus durables, en particulier le réemploi des bouteilles en verre. Ils permettent également de mieux comprendre comment le marché de la consigne se structure en France.

👉 Pourquoi agir ?
Parce que 40 % des émissions de CO₂ d’un domaine viticole proviennent des bouteilles en verre à usage unique.

🎯 Notre ambition : faire du réemploi la nouvelle norme.

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable.

This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release

• Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals

• Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls

• Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams

• Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD)

• Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification

• Interface with

description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Financial Planning & Analysis to build and lead our FP&A function. The company has recently raised significant funding, and it needs a hands-on leader to turn that strategy into agreed company targets, realistic budgets, clear spending priorities, and reporting leadership can rely on. You will build the financial model from scratch, set up the planning process, and give the CFO and executive team the numbers and recommendations they need to make decisions. Over ons

De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Wij verbinden chips met computernetwerken die enorme hoeveelheden data verwerken, met minimale vertraging. Samen veranderen we de manier waarop de wereld met elkaar verbonden is.

In Zoetermeer werkt ons grafeenteam aan de toekomst van de halfgeleiderindustrie, van onderzoek en ontwikkeling tot industrialisatie. Op het snijvlak van materiaalkunde en halfgeleidertechnologie ontwikkelt het team de processen om grafeen te produceren, te karakteriseren en te integreren. Die processen vormen de basis van onze geïntegreerde grafeenfotonica. Het team pioniert met nieuwe procestechnologie en schaalt die op tot productierijpe oplossingen. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen.

De functie

Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken.

Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving.

title: Senior-Consultant / Berater (d/w/m)
description:
Wer wir sind

Meliorate ist eine Managementberatung mit Standorten in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und München.
Wir beraten Unternehmen mit komplexen, asset-intensiven Geschäftsmodellen – zum Beispiel Netzbetreiber aus der Energie- oder Wasserwirtschaft – bei strategischen und organisatorischen Fragestellungen.

Dabei arbeiten wir eng mit unseren Kund:innen zusammen und verbinden fundierte Analysen mit einem klaren Fokus auf Umsetzbarkeit.

Unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von klaren Erwartungen, direktem Feedback und dem Anspruch, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Deine Rolle

Du übernimmst in Projekten eigenständig Verantwortung und arbeitest an strategischen Fragestellungen unserer Kund:innen.

Im Detail bedeutet das:

  • Du analysierst strategische und organisatorische Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team strukturierte und umsetzbare Lösungen

  • Du strukturierst komplexe Problemstellungen, wertest Daten aus und leitest fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen ab (z. B. Benchmarks, Abweichungsanalysen)

  • Du präsentierst Ergebnisse und arbeitest mit Stakeholder:innen auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen

  • Du übernimmst eigenständig Arbeitspakete und trägst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung

  • Du baust Dir ein eigenes Netzwerk bei Kund:innen auf und entwickelst Deine Rolle im Projektteam weiter

  • Du bringst Dich in interne Themen ein und unterstützt den Aufbau von Wissen innerhalb des Unternehmens

Was Dich bei uns erwartet

Du arbeitest in Projektteams, in denen Du Verantwortung übernimmst und Deine Themen eigenständig vorantreibst.

title: Founding GTM & Sales Manager - DACH & Nordics (gn) @ AI Digital Defense Venture, Germany
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We build frontier artificial intelligence that helps governments and defence organisations make sense of a fast-moving information environment. Our systems help the teams responsible for national security read a complex information environment faster and clearer than ever before. We've closed a pre-seed round and are already running live government pilots, with plans to expand across Europe and beyond. This is an early, venture-backed company doing work that carries weight.

About the Role

This is a founding role for our expansion across the DACH region and the Nordics. You will own how we grow here, from the first conversation through to a signed contract, building the region much as we built the UK: learning the landscape, opening doors, landing pilots and turning them into long-term contracts. You will work closely with the founders and with a forward-deployed engineer who builds the tools, integrations and prototypes that a live sales process needs, so your job is to win the room, work out what the customer actually needs, and direct that build until the deal closes.

What you'll do

  • Own go-to-market across the DACH region and the Nordics, winning and growing contracts across government, defence and large enterprise, from first conversation through to close.

  • Map the region from a blank slate, find the advisory relationships that open doors, and build a network where we do not have one yet.

title: Staff Engineer (m|w|d) - CRM Tech
description:
Reliable data, resilient services and scalable architectures are at the heart of every CRM interaction at idealo. As a Staff Engineer, you'll shape the technical foundation behind identity resolution, subscriptions, data flows, and message delivery while ensuring GDPR compliance and supporting personalized user experiences.

This role combines backend engineering, data engineering and architectural leadership. You'll influence how data flows across systems, how services communicate through event-driven architectures, and how technical decisions support idealo's long-term CRM strategy. Working closely with Software Engineers, Data Engineers and Product Managers, you'll help define technical direction across multiple domains.

You'll work with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Braze, Snowflake and AWS services including Glue, Lambda and S3 in a modern cloud-native architecture. From data ingestion and transformation to customer-facing activation, you'll help build reliable systems that teams across idealo depend on every day. When new CRM capabilities go live, you'll see the direct impact of your work in millions of customer interactions.

The position is available in full or part-time.

About your new role

  • Design, implement, maintain, and evolve reliable and scalable software systems and data flows for CRM and user engagement use cases.  

  • Stay hands-on by designing and developing cloud-native microservices, event-driven applications and backend services with a strong focus on performance, security and operational excellence.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - Checkout & Payments (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Als Senior Quality Engineer – Checkout & Payments trägst du dazu bei, zuverlässige Zahlungsabläufe über Shopware, Shopware Payments und externe Systeme hinweg sicherzustellen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf praxisnahen Integrationstests, Testautomatisierung und Release-Validierung: Du prüfst, ob Kund:innen einen Kauf erfolgreich abschließen können, Bestell- und Zahlungsstatus korrekt sind und Fehler sowie Wiederholungsversuche sicher verarbeitet werden.

Du wirst Teil des Bereichs Quality Operations innerhalb von Delivery Excellence und arbeitest eng mit den Teams Checkout & Payments, dem Produktmanagement und weiteren Quality Engineers zusammen. Du bringst Qualität früh in die Feature-Planung ein, überführst Produktrisiken in ausführbare Tests, untersuchst Fehler und gibst klare Empfehlungen zur Release-Bereitschaft. Die Position ist eine Senior-Engineering-Rolle ohne Führungsverantwortung. Du entwickelst das bestehende Framework für Abnahmetests und die CI-Infrastruktur weiter, statt eine separate Testorganisation aufzubauen.


  • Risikobasierte Testabdeckung definieren und umsetzen. Arbeite mit Product und Engineering zusammen, um kritische Abläufe für Händler:innen und Kund:innen, die vorhandene Testabdeckung und Lücken zu identifizieren. Stimme für jedes Entwicklungspaket einen klar abgegrenzten Testumfang ab und begleite ihn durch Umsetzung, Review und Validierung.

  • Entwickle und verbessere wiederverwendbare Sicherheitskontrollen, Leitfäden für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler, Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien und praxisnahe Automatisierung zur Erkennung und Behebung von Schwachstellen.

Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Baue eine dauerhafte Product-Security-Engineering-Funktion für die Shopware-Produkte auf. Das Team verhindert wiederkehrende Schwachstellenklassen, schafft klare Zuständigkeiten und Reaktionszeiten für Sicherheitsaufgaben und unterstützt die Produktteams dabei, Risiken zu beheben, bevor daraus Sicherheitsvorfälle mit Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden entstehen.

Product Security Engineering ist von der bestehenden SecOps- bzw. Information-Security-Funktion abgegrenzt. Die Funktion verantwortet die Ergebnisse im Bereich Product Security Engineering und das Betriebsmodell für diese Arbeit. Sie ersetzt weder die Governance durch InfoSec noch die Verantwortung der Engineering-Domänen, die Freigabe durch Quality oder Product Operations.


  • Entwickle und leite eine risikobasierte Product-Security-Roadmap für Commerce Core, Services und weitere Produktbereiche. Sorge für eine ausgewogene Gewichtung von Prävention, Erkennung, Incident-Bereitschaft und Behebung.

Vereinbare Schweregrade und Reaktionsziele mit den Domänenverantwortlichen und InfoSec, leite jeden Vorgang an den zuständigen Code Owner weiter und mache die laufenden Reaktionsfristen sichtbar.

title: Business Development and GTM Lead - PreSeed Proptech (Rudi)
description:
Rudi is building the AI knowledge and decision layer for the skilled trades.

Today, diagnosing a technical fault often depends on who happens to be on site. Experienced Meisters rely on years of tacit knowledge, technical documentation and intuition. Less experienced technicians frequently need additional visits or senior support.

Rudi makes that expertise available to every technician and across trades. Our AI assistant guides technicians through diagnosis and repair, combines manufacturer knowledge with real service experience, and learns from the outcome of every job.

Our ambition is to make every technician perform closer to the best Meister in the organisation — and ultimately build the intelligence layer for technical field services across the skilled trades.

Rudi is being built with Founders Factory and a large European residential and field service organisation. The first product is already being tested with experienced Meisters, with live field pilots starting shortly.

The role

Your mission is to validate Rudi's commercial potential beyond our launch partner, identify promising customer segments and build an initial sales pipeline.

This is a hands-on role focused on customer outreach, commercial validation and early sales opportunities — not a desk research or purely strategic consulting assignment. description:
Über Scento

Scento ist Europas größte Website für Parfum-Abfüllungen. Das 2024 gegründete Unternehmen hat seinen Hauptsitz in Paris an der Place Vendôme und ein zweites Büro in Berlin. Scento bietet mehr als 1.000 originale Designer- und Nischendüfte aus einem Portfolio von 200 Parfumhäusern als Abfüllungen an: Fläschchen mit 2 ml, 5 ml und 8 ml sowie bei den meisten Düften eine 30-ml-Flasche. Mit Parfumproben von Nischen- und Designerdüften lässt sich ein Duft entdecken, bevor man sich für einen ganzen Flakon entscheidet. Jedes Parfum ist ein Original von autorisierten europäischen Händlern, und jede Flasche durchläuft vor dem Abfüllen eine 12-Punkte-Eingangsprüfung in Scentos ISO-zertifizierter Einrichtung.

Scento beliefert Kundinnen und Kunden in 27 europäischen Märkten und versendet in 26 EU-Länder. Scentos Jahresumsatz liegt 2026 bei mehr als 30 Millionen Euro, online und offline zusammen. Auf Scento.com war der monatliche Absatz von Abfüllungen im September 2026 3,2-mal so hoch wie im Januar 2026. Nach eigenen Angaben verkauft Scento mehr als 3 Millionen Parfum-Abfüllungen pro Jahr, etwa eine alle 10 Sekunden. Im November 2025 kündigte Scento an, über drei Jahre 25 Millionen Euro in die Entdeckung von Parfum in Europa zu investieren.

title: Business Development Intern (GTM) (m/f/d)
description:
About Ordio

80% of the world’s workforce doesn’t sit at a desk, yet most software is built for the 20% who do. Ordio is the AI-native workforce management (WFM) system for deskless workforces: shift planning, time tracking and payroll for the people who keep restaurants, shops and services running.

The role

This is not a “support the team and update spreadsheets” internship. You’ll help find out where Ordio’s next stage of growth comes from, and then make it happen. You get real problems and the tools to solve them, and nobody tells you how.

What you will do

  • Get to product-market fit in new verticals. Find out which industries need Ordio most, validate quickly and build the go-to-market for them

  • High agency: you don’t wait for instructions, you figure it out and ship

  • Obsessed with understanding problems, customers and markets before jumping to solutions

  • You already use AI tools beyond ChatGPT prompts, e.g. agents and automations

  • Analytical and numbers-driven, comfortable making decisions with incomplete data

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Student (Bachelor/Master)

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

title: Major Gifts Officer
description:
Mozilla Foundation is a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination.

We deliver people-first alternatives to today’s extractive systems. We build side by side with developers, innovators and advocates, united in the belief that a better technology future is not only possible — it’s ours to create!

Team

Major Gifts are becoming a load-bearing part of how Mozilla Foundation funds its mission — and that revenue doesn't materialize on its own. Someone has to build real relationships with donors capable of giving at the $50,000 to $1M+ level, and turn those relationships into closed gifts rather than a portfolio that's always “warming up.”

That's this role.   • Get up to speed on Mozilla's existing major gift portfolio and pipeline in Salesforce, and start building relationships with current donors.
  • Move existing prospects who are already in active cultivation toward a solicitation.
  • Partner with prospect research to identify and begin qualifying new major gift prospects for your portfolio.
  • Help plan and deliver a stewardship touchpoint or donor event that deepens an existing major donor relationship.
  • Start shaping a tailored proposal or impact story, drawing on input from program and executive staff, for one of your priority donors.

  • Help the major gifts program consistently hit its revenue targets.
  • Manage a portfolio of major donor relationships, systematically advancing prospects through cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Keep every meaningful donor interaction documented in Salesforce, so relationship history is accurate and the next move is always clear.

title: Principal, User Research
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

At Mural, we believe great collaboration starts with deep understanding. Our mission is to help teams think and work together better. The Design and Research team uncovers the truths that power that mission, guiding product, design, and strategy through rigorous, human-centered inquiry. We combine behavioral science, market insight, and creative exploration to shape Mural’s future for how teams ideate, align, and collaborate together across the world.

YOUR MISSION

As the Principal, User Researcher at Mural, you’ll start a UX research practice and lead foundational and strategic research that shapes how the company defines its next generation of experiences. You’ll partner across product, design, sales, marketing, and strategy to identify new opportunity spaces, clarify evolving user needs, and guide the organization toward long-term innovation.

This is a primarily individual-contributor role focused on uncovering deep human collaboration insights that drive strategy, innovation, and long-term vision. You’ll also help shape and scale the UXR discipline at Mural by mentoring designers to confidently run tactical usability studies, and establishing the frameworks and best practices that elevate research across the company. Think of it as being the first research leader at a fast-growing startup, with the reach and resources of a global platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Player Responsibilities (Individual Contributor Work):

  • Lead mixed-methods research (qualitative and quantitative) that explores user needs, behaviors, and motivations across multiple product areas.

  • Drive foundational studies that reveal how teams collaborate and what barriers exist in business collaboration, hybrid, and distributed work.

  • Design and execute medium to large-scale studies that combine qualitative depth with quantitative rigor (surveys, logs analysis, segmentation, and concept testing).

  • Develop a tempo where actionable insights are timely and urgently positioned to shape key product decisions.

  • Translate ambiguous questions into clear learning plans and frameworks that guide product and strategy decisions.

  • Build artifacts (archetypes, frameworks, journey maps, mental models) that make complex insights accessible and actionable across the company, leveraging Mural products.

  • Present insights to an executive, cross-functional audience and provide strategic recommendations based on these insights.

Coach Responsibilities:

  • Build the research practice: mentor designers, and product partners in research best practices, helping to scale a culture of curiosity and evidence-based decision making.

  • Establish repeatable, high-quality research

title: Engineering Manager - EU
description:
Hi I’m Colin, Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby.

To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.

When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).

To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.

We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe.

In addition to working with engineers you’ll also get to work on projects yourselves. Some examples of work our engineering leaders have done:

  • Provide feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

  • Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects, and deliver them with little interventi

Hi! I'm Chris, head of Product Design at Ashby.

We're looking for a versatile, intrinsically motivated designer who is excited to contribute to rethinking how modern software is designed. At Ashby, you'll be part designer, part product manager, part consultant, and part design system manager (or some combination of the 4!). We do design differently here, and if that excites you, read on.

Our unique approach is working - we're growing >100% year-over-year and have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, very low churn, and many years of runway. We're backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more! We’ll share more details once we meet.

How We Work

In my previous roles, product teams always consisted of a product manager, a designer, and ~4-5 engineers. This may sound familiar to you! The product manager briefs the designer who then designs. After designing, mocks are handed to the engineers.

We take a more principled approach here at Ashby. If you've been designing software enough, you'll realize in actuality, design is required in varying degrees on each project. Sometimes in the past, I'd be asked to design yet another settings page, when really all that was needed was an engineer to reuse existing components and just follow some documentation I had written. Other times, I felt I should effectively be the product manager and own a project from beginning to end. In these latter cases, it made sense that I was even the one providing project updates and managing resources rather than constantly being pinged by a separate product manager.

This principled approach is now what we do here, and it is part of what has allowed Ashby to take down incumbents in multiple verticals all at once. We don't settle for the status quo—we actively resist reversion to the mean.

Both Abhik and Benji (our founders) care deeply about design, which at first glance may seem counterintuitive given the number of full-time designers that we employ. title: Senior Account Manager DACH
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

title: Staff Backend Engineer
description:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

That takes high standards, high velocity and engineers who own what they ship.

Today, we serve over 6 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management. At that scale, performance, reliability and data integrity are part of the product.

Our platform is powered by a modern, high-performance engineering stack designed for scale and reliability: Java 21 (Spring), Go, Node.js (TypeScript), PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Redis, Kafka, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, Docker, Grafana, AWS, Kubernetes and Kibana.

About the role

Staff Backend Engineers shape technical direction across teams while remaining close to the systems and code. You will take on problems whose consequences extend beyond one service or delivery cycle.

This is not a people-management role. Its leverage comes from technical judgement, credible execution and the ability to help other engineers make better decisions.

What you’ll do

  • Own high-consequence backend problems that span services, teams or product domains.

  • Establish clear system boundaries and architectural direction without creating unnecessary central control.

  • Lead technical decisions by making constraints, alternatives, risks and trade-offs explicit.

  • Improve performance, resilience, data integrity, operability and failure handling across production systems.

  • Resolve recurring structural problems rather than treating symptoms team by team.

description:
WORUM ES GEHT

Du übernimmst die Finanzbuchhaltung von Thorit, hands-on und eigenständig. Zusammen mit unserem CFO bist du das Finance-Team: Du buchst selbst, hältst die Zahlen sauber und gestaltest mit, wie unsere Finanzprozesse künftig aussehen.

Wir sind eine AI-Beratung. Was wir bei unseren Kunden automatisieren, wollen wir auch intern umsetzen, und die Finanzbuchhaltung bietet sich dafür besonders an. Deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der sauber bucht und gleichzeitig Lust hat, Abläufe neu zu denken.

  • Du buchst eigenständig in DATEV: Kreditoren, Debitoren, Sachkonten und Bankabstimmung

  • Du räumst Altbestände auf und hältst die offenen Posten aktuell

  • Du bereitest den Monatsabschluss vor und machst daraus einen dokumentierten, wiederholbaren Prozess

  • Du sorgst für korrekte und fristgerechte Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen

  • Du rechnest Reisekosten ab

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Steuerkanzlei und begleitest den Jahresabschluss

  • Du schaust dir unsere Abläufe kritisch an und automatisierst, was sinnvoll ist, zum Beispiel Belegzuordnung, Abstimmungen oder Auswertungen

  • Du übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Aufgaben, die heute noch extern laufen

  • Du dokumentierst unsere Finance-Prozesse in Confluence

title: Graphene Photonics Data Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

description:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy.

More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

What you'll do

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Talk to customers, build across the whole stack, and ship to production. Turn what AI can do today into features that procurement and engineering teams use every day. You’re done when it drives revenue, not when it’s merged. Don’t wait for a PRD.

What we mean by Builder

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles.

A Builder takes a messy, unclear problem and owns it from start to finish. That goes for business problems, not just customer problems. You decide what’s worth doing, make the case for it, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When something works, you share it so everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

How we build - The Tacto Engineer

Builder is the what. The Tacto Engineer is the how. It’s our engineering practice and the bar we hold each other

title: Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais (H/F)
description:
Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais  (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais.  Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients.

Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise.

Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements).

Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production.

Vos missions

Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais

  • Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression.
  • Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consult

En tant que data scientist, vous rejoindrez l'équipe Pulsar aux côtés de trois autres data scientists.

🎯 MISSIONS

Veepee développe des algorithmes de pointe en matière de prévision et de tarification, qui constituent des priorités stratégiques pour l’entreprise.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI
description:
About

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

Build and improve ML systems that power our AI-native applications.

Work on classification, retrieval, ranking, personalization and evaluation, taking ownership from model development to production deployment.

This role is for engineers who enjoy solving practical ML problems, improving model quality and shipping reliable systems used by real users.

 

Focus

  • Build and improve ML models for classification, ranking, retrieval and personalization.

  • Develop efficient classifiers and optimize model accuracy, precision, latency and cost.

  • Improve search relevance and context retrieval using embeddings, hybrid search and reranking.

  • Build personalization models that learn from user behavior while respecting privacy.

title: Full-Stack Engineer — AI Authoring Platform
description:
About Tracium

Tracium builds AI-assisted technical documentation software for teams working with complex manuals and engineering information. Our platform combines document intelligence with S1000D authoring, initially serving maritime use cases.

We want technical authors to spend less time managing document complexity and more time producing accurate, useful information.

Your role

You will turn our AI and document processing capabilities into a product that technical authors and engineers can use confidently. You will work across the authoring interface, backend services, and integrations.

What you’ll do

  • Build an intuitive editor that lets users create structured technical documentation without working directly with XML tags.

  • Develop interfaces for reviewing extracted information and AI suggestions alongside their sources.

  • Create workflows for editing, validation, version comparison, and document export.

  • Build backend APIs and integrate document processing and AI services.

  • Implement access controls, audit history, and reliable handling of long-running tasks.

  • Improve responsiveness and performance when working with large documents.

  • Work closely with the founders and domain experts to translate feedback into product improvements.

What you bring

  • Experience shipping and maintaining production web applications.

  • Strong TypeScript and React skills, or experience with a comparable modern frontend framework.

  • Backend development experience with Python or Node.js.

  • Experience designing APIs and working with relational databases.

  • A practical approach to testing, security, accessibility, and maintainable code.

title: Senior Data Engineer — Document & AI Pipelines
description:
About Tracium

Tracium builds AI-assisted technical documentation software that turns complex manuals and engineering documents into structured, traceable information. Starting with maritime, we help technical teams extract maintenance information and create documentation through document intelligence and S1000D authoring.

Your role

You will build the data foundation connecting source documents, AI processing, human review, and downstream systems. Your focus will be reliable processing, clear data models, and traceability throughout the document lifecycle.

What you’ll do

  • Design document ingestion and processing pipelines for PDFs, XML, and related technical data.

  • Build workflows for parsing, enrichment, validation, indexing, and export.

  • Define data models for document structure, extracted entities, maintenance tasks, and source references.

  • Implement document versioning, processing history, and reproducible reprocessing.

  • Make pipelines resilient through retries, monitoring, automated checks, and clear failure handling.

  • Work with AI engineers to productionise extraction and retrieval workflows.

  • Support integrations with authoring tools, customer APIs, and ERP systems.

What you bring

  • Experience designing and operating production data pipelines.

  • Strong Python, SQL, and data modelling skills.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration, asynchronous processing, and object storage.

  • A practical approach to testing, observability, and data quality.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, and infrastructure as code.

  • The ability to take ownership from initial design through production support.

  • Clear communication in English.

Useful additional experience

  • Document processing, XML.

title: Senior AI Engineer — Document Intelligence
description:

Tracium builds AI-assisted technical documentation software that turns complex manuals and engineering documents into structured, traceable information. Our initial focus is maritime, with applications across manufacturing, aerospace, and defence.

You will own the AI capabilities behind our document intelligence platform—from understanding complex PDFs to extracting information that engineers can review and use.

  • Develop retrieval and AI workflows for technical question answering and maintenance information extraction.

  • Design structured outputs with validation and references to source documents.

  • Build evaluation datasets and measure extraction accuracy, retrieval quality, and unsupported outputs.

  • Improve model performance, processing speed, and cost across cloud and private deployments.

  • Work with product and engineering colleagues to bring prototypes into production.

What you bring

  • Experience delivering AI or machine learning systems into production.

  • Practical experience with LLMs, structured extraction, retrieval, and evaluation.

  • The ability to investigate failures systematically and make clear technical trade-offs.

  • Clear communication in English.

  • Technical manuals, industrial documentation

title: Head of Finance (w/d/m)
description:
Über LIFTED

LIFTED is a strength training company from Berlin. We run six studios across the city and plan to have 20 by the end of 2027, with Munich, Hamburg, Cologne and Düsseldorf next. Our goal is to become the largest fitness company in Europe. Before LIFTED, the founding team helped build and scale BEAT81. Today we’re profitable and owner-led.

Why this role exists
Today Carl, one of the founders, runs finance alongside managing the company, with bookkeeping at an external tax firm. You take this over and build the finance team.


Your role
You report to Carl, sit in the management meeting and approve spending within budget.


What you own

  • Finance ops. You lead our finance trainee, who handles receipts, invoices and account coding based on clear rules. You review samples, resolve new cases and adapt the rules. You also manage payments, payroll and the month-end and year-end close with our tax firm.

  • Planning and liquidity. You own our planning model, plan liquidity monthly, and run the annual and three-year budget, forecasts and scenarios. Before we sign a new location, you build its business case and add it to the planning model.

  • Reporting. You set up monthly management reporting that we use in the management meeting.

  • Financing. You prepare our financing and, over time, lead parts of the conversations with our financing partners.

  • HR admin. You handle employee data and contracts. Right now that’s a few hours a month.

  • Team. You build the finance team and help us decide when HR needs its own role.

How we measure success

  • After 3 months, you’ve taken over finance from Carl, from daily operations and HR admin to planning and liquidity.</

Sereact is a Series B embodied-AI company. Cortex, our VLA model, is deployed in live warehouse robotic cells across the EU and US. Zurich is our newest research hub, focused on the manipulation and control problems that sit underneath Cortex.

title: Total Rewards & People Business Partner
description:
People Business Partner & Total Rewards

Most People roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, and to own one of them outright: how Eye rewards and recognises its people. You’ll do that while partnering the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn’t it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading.

The role

This role has two halves, and you’ll split your time roughly evenly between them.

The first half is Total Rewards. You’ll own compensation and benefits at Eye, including salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling, benefits and our equity program. There’s no finished framework waiting for you. You’ll shape it, make it hold up as we grow, and get us ready for EU pay transparency. You don’t need to be a reward specialist yet. If you owned reward projects before and want to make this your expertise, this is where you do it.

The second half is partnering. You’ll be the People Business Partner for our core business: security operations, incident response, customer support & onboarding, and project management. It’s the most varied population in the company: working students running shift rosters next to deeply specialized senior engineers, and managers at very different stages of their leadership journey.

That mix is exactly why this role needs presence more than years. You’ll coach a first-time manager on the basics one hour and align a salary band with C-level the next. You’ll need to be comfortable doing both, and to enjoy it.

What you’ll do

title: Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer – Extreme Environments (all genders)
description:
Your Mission:

As Senior Thermomechanical Analysis Engineer (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable.

Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements.

Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

Du verantwortest Produkt und Produktisierung – Engineering, Delivery, Sales und Product Marketing bleiben für Umsetzung, Kundenprojekt, Opportunity und Vermarktung zuständig. Darüber hinaus verantwortest Du den Lifecycle bestehender Produkte: Du sicherst ihre Stärken und Standards und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Validierte Lösungen konsequent in wiederholbare, standardisierte Angebote überführen

  • Zielkunden, Pain, Business Value und Value Proposition schärfen

  • Klaren Standardumfang und klare Produktgrenzen definieren – inklusive dessen, was bewusst nicht dazugehört
