title: Patient Support Coordinator
description:
At Montu, our Patient Support team plays an important role in ensuring patients feel informed, supported and cared for throughout their treatment journey.

We are looking for a Patient Support Coordinator to join our Pharmacy Support team at Winnersh Triangle. This is a busy, fast-paced and predominantly telephone-based role, supporting patients with prescription queries, medication availability, deliveries and any issues that may arise along the way.

Many of our patients are managing complex health conditions, so we need someone who understands that behind every call is a person relying on us to get things right. Whether you are resolving a delayed prescription, providing reassurance or working with our Pharmacy team to find a solution, the way you communicate and support our patients really matters.

This is not your typical customer service role. It requires patience, empathy, resilience and exceptional attention to detail. You will need to be comfortable managing challenging conversations, working under pressure and taking ownership of queries in a highly regulated healthcare environment.

Previous healthcare experience would be an advantage, but what matters most is your ability to communicate with compassion, remain calm under pressure and genuinely care about the difference you can make.

What is the job?

As a Patient Support Coordinator, you will be the first point of contact for patients with pharmacy and medication-related queries, ensuring they receive clear, accurate and timely information.

You will work closely with our Pharmacy, Clinical and wider Patient Support teams to resolve issues, provide updates and help ensure patients receive their medication safely and efficiently.

title: Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI
description:
About

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

Build and improve ML systems that power our AI-native applications.

Work on classification, retrieval, ranking, personalization and evaluation, taking ownership from model development to production deployment.

This role is for engineers who enjoy solving practical ML problems, improving model quality and shipping reliable systems used by real users.

 

Focus

  • Build and improve ML models for classification, ranking, retrieval and personalization.

  • Develop efficient classifiers and optimize model accuracy, precision, latency and cost.

  • Improve search relevance and context retrieval using embeddings, hybrid search and reranking.

  • Build personalization models that learn from user behavior while respecting privacy.

Kijimea – Aus der Forschung. Für Dein Leben. Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2011 verfolgen wir eine klare Vision: Wir möchten das Potenzial der Mikrobiota (Bakterien) in unserem Darm gezielt nutzen für ein längeres und gesünderes Leben - für alle Menschen.

Ein erster großer Meilenstein auf diesem Weg gelang uns bereits 2013 mit der Entdeckung und klinischen Erforschung des einzigartigen Bakterienstamms B. bifidum MIMBb75 (Kijimea Reizdarm). Kurz gesagt: Wir untersuchen, wie die Bakterien in unserem Darm Einfluss auf ein längeres und gesünderes Leben nehmen.

Heute zählen wir zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen weltweit. Unsere Kunden erreichen wir über verschiedenste Kanäle: über die direkte Kommunikation mit Ärzten und Apothekern sowie Print-, TV- und Digitalmarketing. Um unser stark wachsendes Geschäft in Europa weiter auszubauen, suchen wir herausragende Talente, die uns bei dieser Mission unterstützen. Unser Ziel ist klar definiert: Bis 2028 wollen wir Kijimea zur weltweit größten DTC-Probiotikamarke machen und damit jährlich über 50 Millionen Menschen ein besseres Leben schenken.

title: Social Media & Project Coordination (m/f/d), Fashion Week Focus
description:
About us
Fashion Revolution Germany e.V. is the German chapter of Fashion Revolution, the global movement for a clean, safe, fair, transparent and accountable fashion industry. Since the Rana Plaza factory collapse in 2013, the movement has asked one question: Who made my clothes? As a non-profit association of designers, educators, communicators and activists, we run campaigns, workshops and events that make fashion’s social and environmental impacts visible and show practical alternatives such as repair, upcycling and circular models.

The project: RE/CLAIMED at Berlin Fashion Week
A key focus of this internship is RE/CLAIMED, a multidisciplinary sustainable fashion show supported by Fashion Revolution Germany. RE/CLAIMED combines upcycled runway looks, dance, live performance, music and interactive installations to change how people value their clothes. After a sold-out first edition in January 2026, the second edition will take place with around 400 guests expected.

Your role
You’ll pilot the day-to-day social media activities for RE/CLAIMED in the run-up to Berlin Fashion Week, during the show and in the follow-up. You’ll also support the coordination of the show and of Fashion Revolution Germany’s projects in Berlin. You’ll work directly with Eric Vincent Vinsonneau, who leads RE/CLAIMED, and alongside our communications partners.

Beyond RE/CLAIMED, you’ll take part in other Fashion Revolution Germany activities in Berlin. One example is our stand at the Alt-Rixdorfer Christmas Market in Neukölln on the weekend of 4–6 December 2026, where you’ll help with preparation, on-site support and social media coverage.

Your tasks

Social media (main focus)

  • Plan and manage the content calendar for RE/CLAIMED’s Instagram, and optionally build a TikTok presence

  • Create posts, stories and reels: behind the scenes, designe

title: Account Executive - UK
description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve

In this role, you will be responsible for developing database objects, optimizing query performance, and writing automated Unix scripts to handle batch processing and data integration tasks. · ETL & Data Integration: Design and manage Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) data pipelines using SQL*Loader, external tables, or native PL/SQL to migrate data from legacy systems and external sources.

· Production Support & Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve, failing batch jobs, and performance bottlenecks in a timely manner.

description:

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. At Flock, we’re transforming the motor fleet insurance landscape with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll play a pivotal role in our mission to deliver smarter, safer, and more cost-effective insurance solutions. You’ll leverage advanced analytics and AI to assess risk, optimise underwriting processes, and create tailored policies that meet the unique needs of our clients. Your expertise will drive our growth, helping us build a future where innovation and excellence in insurance are the norm. If you’re passionate about making an impact, thrive in a dynamic startup environment, and are ready to lead the charge in redefining fleet insurance, we want you on our team!

title: Key Account Manager, Vantaa
description: Titteli:   Key Account Manager, Vantaa   Hakuaika päättyy:   01.11.2026   Yritys:   Caverion Suomi Oy   Sijainti:   Vantaa   Toimiva työarki ei synny itsestään. Se rakentuu selkeistä tavoitteista, yhteen hiileen puhaltavasta tiimistä ja johtamisesta, joka antaa tilaa onnistumiselle. Meillä Caverionilla pääset rakentamaan toimivaa arkea – ihmisille, kiinteistöille ja teollisuudelle. Esihenkilönä vaikutat paitsi tiimisi onnistumiseen, myös siihen, millaiseksi asiakkaiden kokemus meistä muodostuu.   Etsimme joukkoomme Key Account Manageria vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Vantaan Vapaalassa sijaitsevaan moderniin toimipisteeseemme.  Tarjolla on monipuolinen ja käytännönläheinen tehtävä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan asiakkuuksien kokonaisvaltaiseen hallintaan ja kehittämiseen. Työ on itsenäistä, mutta et ole yksin – tukenasi on motivoitunut ja avulias asiantuntijatiimi sekä caverit ympäri Suomen.  Tehtävässä toimit esihenkilönä huoltopäälliköille ja asiantuntijoille, joiden tiimeissä työskentelee kiinteistötekniikan osaajia.   Päivittäiseen työhösi kuuluu:      Vastaat teknisen kiinteistöhuollon tiimin toiminnasta ja huoltopäälliköiden esihenkilötyöstä.  Varmistat tiimin sujuvan yhteistyön, hyvän työilmapiirin ja motivaation.  Olet kiinnostunut hallinnoimaan ja ohjaamaan operatiivista huollon toimintaa.  Varmistat laadukkaan palvelun tuottamisen yhdessä tiimisi kanssa ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä muiden palveluliiketoimintojen cavereiden kanssa.  Vastaat vastuullasi olevien asiakkuuksien kokonaisvaltaisesta kehityksestä, hallinnasta ja hoidosta.  Seuraat taloutta ja vastaat toiminnan taloudellisista tavoitteista.  Raportoit säännöllisesti asiakkaille ja yksikönpäällikölle.  Osallistut aktiivisesti lisämyyntiin, tarjouspyyntöihin, tarjouskierroksiin ja hinnoitteluun yhteistyössä muiden tekniikkalajien kanssa.      Oletko sinä toimivan elämän tekijä?   Viihdyt varmasti Caverionilla, jos sinulla on:     Laaja-alainen ymmärrys kiinteistötekniikan kokonaisuuksista sekä esimerkiksi AMK-tutkinto LVIS- tai kiinteistötekniikan alalta.  Kokemusta toimihenkilöiden johtamisesta ja esihenkilötyöstä sekä kyky innostaa, motivoida ja kehittää henkilöstöä.  Vahvaa osaamista asiakassuhteiden hallinnasta, hoidosta sekä asiakasraportoinnista.  Hyvät valmiudet hyödyntää tietojärjestelmiä liiketoiminnan seurannassa ja raportoinnissa. SAP-toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän ja Power BI:n osaaminen katsotaan eduksi.  Erinomaiset vuorovaikutustaidot, päätöksentekokykyä ja tavoitteellista johtamisotetta.     Tehtävään valitulle henkilölle tehdään turvallisuusselvitys hänen suostumuksellaan.   Entä mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?   ✅ Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön ja oman tiimin tuen, laajat koulutus- ja kehitysmahdollisuudet sekä avoimen ja osallistavan työkulttuurin.  ✅ Selkeät tavoitteet, jotka auttavat sinua onnistumaan työssäsi. Palkitsemme hyvästä suorituksesta.  ✅ Ensiluokkaiset työvälineet tukemaan työskentelyäsi.  ✅ Laajat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut.

title: Avainasiakaspäällikkö Reilaan
description: Haluatko päästä rakentamaan markkinoiden parasta asiakkuusjohtamista?   Reila on nopeasti kasvava valtakunnallinen turvallisuus- ja käteispalveluyritys. Palvelemme tuhansia asiakaskohteita turvallisuus-, käteisrahahuollon, palvelukeskus- ja turvatekniikkapalveluiden alueilla. Tavoitteemme on tarjota alan paras asiakaskokemus.  Etsimme nyt joukkoomme kokenutta  Avainasiakaspäällikköä  vastaamaan strategisista asiakkuuksista sekä kehittämään Reilan asiakkuusjohtamisen mallia koko organisaatiossa kaupallisessa roolissa.   Mitä tehtäviisi kuulu?   Tehtävässä yhdistyvät avainasiakkuuksien johtaminen, liiketoiminnan kehittäminen ja asiakaskokemuksen parantaminen. Vastaat nimettyjen asiakkuuksien pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä, tyytyväisyydestä, kasvusta ja kannattavuudesta. Samalla toimit Reilan asiakkuusjohtamisen mallin omistajana ja kehittäjänä.  Keskeisiä vastuitasi ovat:    strategisten asiakkuuksien johtaminen ja kehittäminen  pitkäjänteisten suhteiden rakentaminen asiakkaiden päätöksentekijöihin  uusien asiakastarpeiden sekä kasvu- ja lisämyyntimahdollisuuksien tunnistaminen  erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen varmistaminen  asiakkuusjohtamisen toimintamallien, mittareiden ja raportoinnin kehittäminen  yhteistyö myynnin, tuotannon, liiketoimintojen ja johdon kanssa  asiakkuuksien tilanteen, kehityssuuntien ja riskien näkyväksi tekeminen johdolle.     Mitä odotamme sinulta?   Sinulla on:    vahvaa kokemusta avainasiakkuuksien johtamisesta ja strategisesta B2B-myynnistä  näyttöjä asiakkuuksien kasvattamisesta ja kehittämisestä  kyky rakentaa luottamuksellisia suhteita asiakkaiden ylimpään johtoon  erinomaiset vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaidot  järjestelmällinen, tavoitteellinen ja kaupallinen työskentelyote  kyky viedä asioita eteenpäin ilman muodollista esihenkilövastuuta  kiinnostusta kehittää toimintamalleja, prosesseja ja asiakaskokemusta.    Kokemus turvallisuus-, teknologia-, kiinteistö-, palvelu- tai asiantuntijaliiketoiminnasta on eduksi. Ennen kaikkea arvostamme liiketoimintaymmärrystä, oikeaa asennetta ja halua kehittää asiakkaidemme liiketoimintaa pitkäjänteisesti.   Miksi Reilaan?   Pääset vaikuttamaan nopeasti kasvavan yrityksen tulevaisuuteen, työskentelemään valtakunnallisten ja strategisesti tärkeiden asiakkaiden kanssa sekä rakentamaan asiakkuusjohtamisen käytäntöjä koko organisaatiolle. Työskentelet tiiviisti yrityksen johdon kanssa ja hyödynnät moderneja digitaalisia työkaluja ja dataa asiakkuuksien johtamisessa.  Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen (5000-6000 eur/kk), tulospalkkiomallin, kattava työsuhde-edut sekä mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäjänteistä uraa kasvavassa yrityksessä.  Reilan kasvu perustuu pitkäjänteisiin kumppanuuksiin, korkeaan palvelulaatuun ja asiakastyytyväisyyteen. Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme enemmän kuin palveluntoimittaja: kumppani, joka auttaa heitä onnistumaan omassa liiketoiminnassaan. Jos ajattelet samalla tavalla, haluamme kuulla sinusta.   Kiinnostuitko?   Lähetä hakemuksesi, CV:si ja palkkatoive

title: Software Engineer, ML Ops and Platform
description:
About the Company:

Tools for Humanity (TFH) designs and builds technology behind World. World is building a real human network designed to accelerate people in the age of AI. As bots and autonomous agents reshape the internet, people, institutions, and applications need a trusted way to confirm who is a real human while preserving privacy. The TFH and World tech stacks make this possible: the Orb verifies real, unique people, World ID proves it privately, and World App puts these capabilities, and more, in people’s hands. Together, they add a human layer to an AI-driven internet.

World is already running at a global scale. More than 17 million people across 160 countries have verified with World ID, and more new Orb verifications take place each week. World App is already among the most used wallets globally. Developers are integrating World ID to build safer online experiences and create spaces where real people can participate, earn, and be recognized in ways AI simply can’t replicate.

Founded in 2019, TFH has more than 400 people across hardware, software, AI, cryptography, mobile engineering, and global operations. Our teams come from OpenAI, Tesla, SpaceX, Apple, Google, Stripe, Meta, Coinbase, Palantir and MIT Media Lab. We’re backed by leading investors, including a16z, Khosla Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Blockchain Capital, Variant, Tiger Global, and Coinbase Ventures, as well as prominent operators and founders across fintech and AI.

title: Sales Advisor (m/w/d)
description:
Werde Sales Advisor (m/w/d) bei Carwow!

UNSERE MISSION

Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel – wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen, inserieren und leasen. Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive-Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt. 2024 wurden über unsere Plattform fast 3 Mrd. £ an Autokäufen und 1,8 Mrd. £ an Fahrzeugverkäufen abgewickelt. Durch die Übernahme von Autovia (AutoExpress und Evo) haben wir unsere Reichweite verdoppelt: 10 Mio. YouTube-Abonnenten, 1,2 Mio. Magazinverkäufe und mehr als 350 Mio. jährliche Online-Leser:innen. Und wir stehen gerade erst am Anfang.

DEINE MISSION

Als Sales Advisor (m/w/d) bist du neben unserem Business Development und dem Account Management der dritte wichtige Baustein unserer Vertriebsspitze. Denn als Sales Advisor sorgst du für ein erstklassiges (Ver)Kaufserlebnis unserer Kund:innen und Partner auf unserer Plattform.

DEINE AUFGABEN

  • Du berätst Verkäufer:innen beim Verkauf ihrer Autos über unsere "Sell My Car"-Plattform und stellst den Kontakt zu Partnerhändlern her, um so ein reibungsloses Kundenerlebnis auf beiden Seiten zu schaffen

  • Dabei kommunizierst du über verschiedene Kanäle wie zum Beispiel Telefon, E-Mail oder WhatsApp, um einen effizienten Verkaufsprozess zu gewährleisten und steigerst so die Zufriedenheit von Verkäufer:innen und Händlern

  • Denn ohne dein Zutun würden viele Verkäufe sprichwörtlich auf der Strecke bleiben, du bist das Bindeglied zwischen Verkäufer:innen und Händlern und sorgst so kontinuierlich für hohe Verkaufsquoten

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer (USA Only, 100% Remote)
description:
About Us
Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale.

We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales.

Close is a CRM built around the communication tools sales teams use every day: email, calling, SMS, workflows, reporting, and AI. Underneath that product is a broad technical surface — Python services and a large application backend, a TypeScript and React frontend, public APIs, Docker and Kubernetes, AWS infrastructure, and integrations with providers that handle sensitive customer data.

Security work happens across it all today, but the ownership is spread across Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security & Trust. We’re hiring our first dedicated Product Security Engineer to make that work systematic. You’ll report to the Backend Platform team manager within EPD (Engineering, Product, and Design), while working across the entire product and infrastructure surface. You’ll find vulnerabilities, determine which findings matter most, and drive them through remediation. Often you’ll fix the problem yourself. You’ll analyze code, build proof-of-concepts, test running applications, tune or replace noisy tools, and automate the repetitive parts of vulnerability management. You’ll partner closely with our Infrastructure team on cloud security, access, and secrets, and with our Security & Trust Lead on GRC Engineering, compliance (SOC 2) goals, audits, and corporate security.

This role is a new one at Close. You’ll have significant room to decide where better tooling, clearer ownership, and a small amount of code can reduce the most risk.

Our stack

Our backend is primarily Python, with Flask and FastAPI services and TaskTiger and Temporal handling much of our asynchronous work. We expose REST and GraphQL APIs and store data in MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticse

  • Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights.
  • User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc.
  • LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

Supabase manages millions of Postgres instances and is growing. We have strong teams across observability, release engineering, and incident management — and we're concentrating our reliability efforts into a dedicated SRE practice that ties the discipline together across the platform.

You'll be embedded within Service Operations, and your primary job is to make every engineering team more reliable — not by owning their infrastructure, but by establishing the practices, frameworks, and feedback loops that let them own reliability themselves. You'll work across the org: sometimes setting the standard, sometimes pair-programming a fix, sometimes helping a team define their error budget, sometimes telling them it's exhausted.

This role is ideal for someone who has a strong vision for how SRE should work and thrives in async, fast-paced environments where influence matters more than authority.

What You'll Own

  • Partner with service teams to define meaningful SLIs and SLOs grounded in customer experience, and build the error budget policies that turn them into engineering decisions

  • Own and evolve the Operational Readiness Review (ORR) process — conducting reviews for new services and major changes across observability, alerting, runbooks, capacity, and graceful degradation

  • Strengthen the incident-to-improvement pipeline: connecting postmortem findings to operational readiness gaps, identifying repeat failure patterns, and driving systemic fixes

  • Act as the reliability expert teams pull in for architecture reviews, failure mode analysis, dependency mapping, and resilience design

  • Identify and quantify operational toil across the org, and build or advocate for automation that eliminates it

  • Help teams design sustainable on-call practices: alert quality, escalation paths, runbook coverage, and noise reduction

  • Track and report on org-wide operational maturity, surfacing systemic gaps and driving remediation

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have 7+ years of experience in SRE, production engineering, or reliability-focused roles, including experience shaping SRE practices and driving adoption across engineering teams

  • Have a software engineering mindset — you write code and build tools, not just configure them

  • Have hands-on experience defining and operationalizing SLOs

description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field.

Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

  • Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

  • Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simul

title: Responsable Qualité Multi-Sites - Piles à Combustible
description:
About EHG

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

 

The opportunity

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

description:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. Seit 1998 in Gründerhand, entwickeln wir Software und beraten Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir setzen auf Cloud Native, modernisieren Software und unterstützen unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten AI-Lösungen.

Wir bauen unseren Businessbereich “Generative AI” aus und suchen dafür dich, um gute Software für Kunden zu bauen, die relevante Probleme löst.

  • Du entwickelst Individualsoftware für verschiedene Kunden und unterschiedlichste Use-Cases auf Basis von LLMs (z. B. GPT, Claude, Mistral) unter Nutzung von Frameworks und Bibliotheken wie LangChain, LangGraph, Open Hermes, Transformers für Generative AI- und RAG-Pipelines.

description:
TLDR: Plinth builds software for charities, foundations and funders. 2,000+ UK organisations use us, we add 7+ clients a month, and we ship constantly. title: Accounts Payable Manager (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial

fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global

fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and

engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial

scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that

promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

We are looking for a dedicated Accounts Payable Manager (f/m/d): someone who runs the bill-to-pay process end-to-end with the rigor a multi-entity, multi-currency environment requires. You will take over AP from our external bookkeeper during the transition period and lead the move from manual processing to automated workflows.

What You'll Do

Own the end-to-end accounts payable process across all Focused Energy entities, from Bill receipt through payment and reconciliation.

Lead the resolution of supplier and internal payment discrepancies, including duplicate invoices and incorrect payments.

Drive timely month-end and year-end close support, including reconciliations, accruals, prepaid expenses, amortization, and AP reporting.

Ensure bills are coded, approved, and paid in line with company policy and segregation-of-duties controls.<

About ALPAMI

At ALPAMI we're building a boutique hospitality brand. ALPAMI operates 200+ keys across the Black Forest, Switzerland, Tirol, and Munich — spanning City Boutique Houses, Tiny Houses in Nature, and Properties as a Service. We're not chasing stars; we're chasing 5-star experiences delivered in our own, unmistakably boutique way.

We're bootstrapped, founder-led, and growing fast — with a clear target of 500 units next year. That means the operational engine behind our guest experience needs to scale just as fast, and that's exactly where you come in.

We're looking for an Operations Manager who reports directly to the MD and, from our Munich HQ, keeps the operational engine behind our guest experience running: you make sure our Customer Care team always has the relevant information at hand, support them in guest communication, and steer our local stakeholders on site. You are the nerve center of ALPAMI's day-to-day: the person who sees every property, every process, and every issue before it becomes a problem — and who fixes it before the guest even notices.

This is not a job for someone who wants a quiet 9-to-5. We're a fast-growing, founder-led company, and we need someone who understands what that actually means in practice: unpredictable days, fast decisions, and a genuine sense of ownership over the outcome. We expect high reachability, hospitality is a 365 day business. If you don’t agree with that, this might not be the right choice for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own operations end-to-end — surveil and continuously improve operational processes and management standards across our entire portfolio of properties

  • Be the single point of contact for our Customer Care team, provide them with relevant, up-to-date property information (access details, house rules, local specifics, open issues) so every guest gets a fast and correct answer

description:

Luminovo builds software that powers the electronics supply chain — and we're growing our OEM segment across the DACH market. As a BDR based in Germany, you'll own the top of the funnel: turning cold outreach into qualified pipeline for our Account Executives.

This is a high-impact role for someone who believes cold calling isn't dead, thrives on outbound, and wants to grow into a closing role in B2B SaaS.

What you'll do

  • Run multichannel outbound sequences — email, phone, LinkedIn, and events — targeting technical buyers at OEMs across the DACH region

  • Use tools like Apollo, Clay, Lusha, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to build and work targeted lead lists

  • Qualify prospects through cold call sequences to identify ICP fit

  • Hand off warm opportunities to Account Executives with clean notes and context

Who you are

  • Required BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS (or strong hunger to break in)

title: Account Executive (AE) | DACH (d/f/m)
description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

title: Software Engineer Internship for HPI Students
description:
About the role

Banks and fintechs use Taktile to automate critical decisions, like credit, fraud, and compliance, in real time.

We're building the infrastructure that makes financial institutions truly AI-native, and we've partnered with the Hasso Plattner Institute (HPI), a leading computer science institute in Europe, to offer a dedicated opportunity designed only for HPI students.

Starting in April 2027, you'll join one of our engineering teams for 6 months in Berlin and ship real features, with experienced engineers mentoring you along the way. Several HPI alumni already work here, from early-career engineers to senior engineers leading major parts of our product.

This program is tailored for Computer Science students eager to gain hands-on industry experience while building the foundations for a world-class engineering career.

If you have strong engineering fundamentals and want to grow fast in a team where what you build reaches customers soon after you ship it, we'd love to hear from you.

 

What You'll Do

  • Depending on your final team, either work on backend components written in Python / FastAPI, hosted on an AWS serverless architecture, or work on React/Typescript front-end components, or a combination of both!

  • Grow as an individual and accelerate your career by learning from our experienced team, contributing to a foundational layer of the product, and joining cross-team learning groups.

title: Senior HW Engineer – PCB Layout
description:
The Opportunity

Lumai's optical engine only works if the electronics around it hold up. Our boards carry large FPGAs and custom ASICs, multi-gigabit links and fine-pitch packages, and they have to be laid out to tolerances that leave no room for guesswork. This role takes the designs coming out of our hardware and SI/PI teams and turns them into manufacturable, high-layer-count boards.

The Role

You will own board layout from schematic handoff to fabrication release. That covers stackups and HDI structures, controlled-impedance routing, differential pairs, length and phase matching, BGA breakout for large fine-pitch devices, and the full manufacturing package: Gerber/ODB++, drill files, assembly drawings and fabrication notes. You will also own the footprint and symbol libraries, the design rules and the CAD standards the rest of the team works to.

What is genuinely hard about it is that the constraints are real and they conflict. Signal integrity, power integrity, thermal and mechanical requirements all land on the same square centimetres, and the fabricator's process limits decide what is actually buildable. You will be the person who turns simulation output into layout rules and who can defend a stackup to a fabricator.

By month six, you will have taken at least one board through to fabrication release, set the libraries and design rules the team works from, and be the first point of contact for our fabricators and assembly houses.

What You'll Do

  • Lay out dense, high-layer-count PCBs from schematic through to fabrication release, using constraint-driven flows.

title: Service delivery manager maritime security
description: Wil jij bijdragen aan veilig werken in en rondom de windparken op de Noordzee? Als Service delivery manager binnen Rijkswaterstaat zorg jij ervoor dat de informatievoorziening (IV), end to end, van de Maritime Security portefeuille betrouwbaar en beschikbaar blijft. Dit doe je voor de Kustwacht, PBNI, Politie en andere partners. Spreekt deze combinatie van techniek, maatschappelijke impact en regie jou aan? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.  Hoe jij bijdraagt  De Noordzee wordt steeds intensiever gebruikt. Met de ontwikkeling van windparken en andere infrastructuur op zee neemt ook het belang van goede beveiliging en betrouwbare informatievoorziening toe. Binnen IV op Zee van Rijkswaterstaat werken we aan systemen die helpen om activiteiten op zee te monitoren en belangrijke infrastructuur te beschermen. Als service delivery manager maritieme security zorg jij ervoor dat deze dienstverlening betrouwbaar functioneert en aansluit op de behoeften van onze partners.  Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de end-to-enddienstverlening binnen de portefeuille maritieme security. Deze bestaat onder andere uit radar- en camerasystemen, sensoren en de bijbehorende dataketens waarmee informatie wordt verzameld, verwerkt en beschikbaar gesteld. Je hoeft niet zelf de technische oplossingen te ontwikkelen, maar begrijpt hoe de verschillende onderdelen samenhangen en weet welke afspraken, mensen en middelen nodig zijn om de dienstverlening goed te organiseren.  Je werkt in een omgeving met uiteenlopende belangen, waarin organisaties zoals de Kustwacht, Defensie, politie, interne Rijkswaterstaat-onderdelen en leveranciers samenwerken. Daarbij spelen niet alleen technische en organisatorische vraagstukken, maar ook politiek-bestuurlijke ontwikkelingen en veiligheidsbelangen een rol. Jij weet deze belangen te doorgronden, partijen bij elkaar te brengen en draagvlak te creëren voor keuzes die nodig zijn om de dienstverlening verder te ontwikkelen.  Omdat maritieme security binnen IV op Zee een relatief nieuw aandachtsgebied is, krijg je te maken met dienstverlening die nog volop in ontwikkeling is. Je zorgt voor duidelijke afspraken over verantwoordelijkheden, prestaties, financiën en samenwerking. Daarnaast bewaak je de overgang van nieuwe systemen vanuit projecten naar de beheerorganisatie en zorg je dat de dienstverlening ook op langere termijn betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig blijft.  Met jouw organisatievermogen, overtuigingskracht en inzicht in complexe samenwerkingsverbanden lever je een bijdrage aan de bescherming van de Nederlandse infrastructuur op zee.  Jouw werkzaamheden    Je voert regie over de end-to-enddienstverlening binnen de portefeuille maritieme security en bewaakt de continuïteit, beschikbaarheid, kwaliteit en financiële beheersing.  Je onderhoudt relaties met opdrachtgevers en stakeholders, waaronder de Kustwacht, Defensie, politie, interne Rijkswaterstaat-onderdelen en externe leveranciers. title: Technisch Service Manager Rotterdam
description: Geen storing te ingewikkeld, geen uitdaging te groot. Als specialist bij Van der Velden weet je precies wat je te doen staat om het rioolstelsel van Nederland in topvorm te houden. Of je nou bij ons op kantoor zit of onderweg bent: jij lost het op.  Dit krijg je van ons  Onze vestiging in Rotterdam biedt jou een zelfstandige en afwisselende functie binnen een betrokken team, met:    25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen;  Een startsalaris tussen €3.391,- en €5.171,- per maand (afhankelijk van ervaring);  Een auto van de zaak;  Een netto representatievergoeding van €45,12;  Veel zelfstandigheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid;  Een goed pensioen via PMT;  Ruimte voor opleiding en doorgroeimogelijkheden.    Dit ga je doen  Als Technisch Servicemanager op onze vestiging in Rotterdam ben jij de uitvoerende spil tussen het team monteurs, je collega’s op kantoor en de klant. Je geeft leiding aan een groep monteurs, coördineert de werkzaamheden en zorgt ervoor dat alles op rolletjes loopt. Je draagt zorg voor een optimale inzet van middelen en personeel, waarbij een hoge bezettingsgraad en productiviteit bij jou altijd op je netvlies staat. Zo’n 60% van je tijd breng je buiten door; in de ochtend voer je een werkplekinspectie uit, en later op de dag zit je met de klant aan tafel om de voortgang van werkzaamheden te bespreken.  Je hebt de leiding over het team, maar je houdt ook het overzicht op het hele project. Daarnaast ben je het aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten en zorg je dat hun vragen snel en goed worden afgehandeld. Jouw analytische blik maakt het mogelijk om in te zien waar we ons kunnen verbeteren.    Leidinggeven aan een team collega’s in het veld en op kantoor;  Verantwoordelijk voor de correcte uitvoering van storingswerkzaamheden bij onze klanten;  Actief bijdragen aan de verbetering van werkprocessen en de optimalisatie van de inzet van middelen;  Opleiden en begeleiden van storingsmonteurs, waarbij jij ook de verantwoordelijkheid pakt voor de functioneringsgesprekken;  Onderhouden van klantrelaties;  Ondersteunen van storingscoördinatoren tijdens piekperiodes door hen telefonisch te assisteren bij binnenkomende meldingen;  Waarborgen van een veilige werkomgeving, waarbij alle relevante wet- en regelgeving strikt wordt nageleefd.     Wat verwachten we van jou?   Geen dag verloopt hetzelfde, dus jij hebt een flexibele instelling waardoor je snel kunt schakelen en altijd overzicht houdt, zelfs in uitdagende situaties.    Minimaal HBO werk- en denkniveau:  Woonachtig in regio Rotterdam;  Je hebt ervaring met leidinggeven in een technische werkomgeving;  Technisch inzicht is jouw sterke kant;  Je bent zowel klant- als resultaatgericht en kunt goed samenwerken;  Je bent 40 uur beschikbaar.    Past dit bij jou? Stuur je CV en een motivatie waarom jij de uitgelezen persoon bent voor deze job. We zijn benieuwd naar jouw verhaal!

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Location: [Switzerland / Remote]  |  Department: Customer / Commercial  |  Reports to: Chief Customer Officer  |  Employment: Full-time       Company Overview   Global trade is becoming more volatile, complex and consequential for international supply chains. Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) can create significant customs duty savings, but many companies leave these opportunities untapped because the rules, data and coordination required are difficult to manage manually.     Besso’s AI-powered trade regulation intelligence platform helps global businesses identify, validate and capture savings from FTAs while reducing administrative burden and improving trade compliance. Our platform analyzes international trade flows across hundreds of FTAs and translates complex Rules of Origin into actionable opportunities.     We work with large multinational companies where realizing value takes more than software implementation. It requires reliable data, stakeholder alignment and disciplined execution to turn identified opportunities into measurable duty savings.      About the Role   We are looking for a customer-focused, commercially minded operator to own the journey from contract signature to realized value—and turn that value into sustained adoption and expansion.  This is not a traditional software implementation or relationship-management role. You will lead onboarding, coordinate Besso and customer teams, drive data collection and validation, and orchestrate the customer-side work needed to move savings opportunities into action. You will also help embed Besso in customers’ ongoing trade and customs processes and identify where further value can be created.     You will work across functions and countries, often influencing people without direct authority. The ultimate measure of success is not whether a project plan is complete or software is deployed, but whether customers realize value and continue to grow their use of Besso.     Customer journey: Contract → Data → Opportunity → Validation → Implementation → Duty Savings → Software Adoption → Expansion      Key Responsibilities    Own customer onboarding and implementation: Build and manage plans, milestones, governance, responsibilities and dependencies from contract signature; coordinate Besso’s Customer, Product, Data and Technology teams; manage risks and maintain momentum.  Orchestrate savings projects: Prioritize opportunities by value, feasibility and customer priorities; establish customer-side ownership; coordinate customs, trade, procurement, logistics, tax, finance, IT and business stakeholders; drive opportunities through validation and implementation.  Drive data collection and quality: Secure customs declarations, product data, HS classifications, origin and supplier information, and other required inputs; identify gaps or inconsistencies; work with customers and internal teams to resolve them and establish repeatable data flows.  Navigate stakeholder complexity: Map decision-maker

title: Customer Success Manager (Nagoya)
description: ※本ポジションは名古屋現地からのフルリモート勤務となり、名古屋市内もしくは移動可能圏内の居住が必要となります。  WHAT IS BOX?  Box(NYSE: BOX)はインテリジェントコンテンツ管理（ICM）プラットフォームのリーディングカンパニーです。Boxのプラットフォームは、企業のコラボレーション促進や、コンテンツのライフサイクル全体の管理、重要なコンテンツの保護、そしてエンタープライズAIによるビジネスワークフローの変革を実現することを目指しています。2005年に米国で設立され、JLL、モルガン・スタンレーなどを含む大手グローバル企業や、日本では22,000社超および日経225の85%の企業の業務効率化を支援しています。  Boxは、カリフォルニア州レッドウッドシティーに本社を置き、米国、ヨーロッパ、アジアに拠点を持っています。株式会社Box Japanは2013年に設立された日本法人です。  Boxでは、重要なコンテンツを扱うプラットフォームをさらに推進し、お客様の働き方に大きな変革を提供する、またとない機会があります。コンテンツは私達の業務の中心にあります。契約書、請求書、社員情報、財務情報、製品仕様、マーケティング資産などの部署間に跨る重要なビジネス・プロセスに含まれる数十億ものファイルや情報が日々流れています。私達のミッションは、コンテンツ管理にインテリジェンスをもたらし、お客様がデジタル・トランスフォーメーションを実現するお手伝いをさせていただくことです。このAIと膨大な業務コンテンツの融合による、大規模な働き方の変革期に、そのビジネスの最前線に貢献することが、Boxではできます。  WHY BOX NEEDS YOU  K.K. Box Japan は Box Inc.の日本支社として 2014 年 5 月に設立され、急成長し続けています。私たちはさらに Box を広め、ともに成長を促進していただくことができる人材を求めております。このポジションでは日本のカスタマーサクセスマネージャーチームの一員として、顧客との関係構築、利用促進、満足度の向上、契約維持などに責任を持って業務を行なっていただきます。   What You'll Do     強固な関係構築、製品知識、計画、実行を通じて、Box のトップ顧客およびエンタープライズ顧客に対するすべての販売後の活動を管理する  Box 製品について深く理解し、顧客に対してビジネスニーズに最も適した機能・特徴を説明する  導入、チェンジマネジメント、定着、活用の計画作成と実行  顧客との定例会議、四半期ヘルスチェックを含む戦略的なレビューなどによるリテンション率向上  解約リスクやヘルススコアを管理し、リスクを除く活動を積極的に行う  営業およびプロフェッショナルサービス部門と連携し、Box を各顧客のコアアーキテクチャの一部にするための計画を策定する  プロダクトおよびエンジニアリング部門と連携し、機能要望や不具合の特定とフォローアップを実施する  顧客の声を代表する立場として機能し、社内へフィードバックを提供する    Box ではコミュニティと対面でのコラボレーションを重要視していてます。Box の社員（Boxers）は、少なくとも毎週3日間以上はオフィスで勤務することが求められます。選考プロセスの中で、リクルーターが働き方や企業文化についてさらに詳しくご説明します。   Who You Are   私たちは「AIファースト」の企業です。  すなわち、常に成長マインドセットを持ちながら仕事に取り組み、AIを活用し、より迅速かつ適切な意思決定を行い、インパクトを高める方法を見つけていくことが求められます。    IT 業界における 3 年以上のアカウントマネジメントの経験  顧客と密に連携し、Box に対する満足度を高め、信頼を得ることができる  限定的な関係構築だけではなく、複数の顧客と接点を持つことができる  基本的な技術知識を有し、顧客からの質問に回答することができる  斬新なアイデアとエネルギーを持ち、チームプレーができる  コンサルティング経験、マーケティング経験があれば尚可  Salesforce や Zendesk、その他の SaaS の業務利用経験があれば尚可  英語力があれば尚可（本社との連携のため）    EQUAL OPPORTUNITY  We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. title: Customer Success Manager - Healthcare AI
description: En Omniloy desarrollamos agentes de inteligencia artificial que ayudan a hospitales y clínicas a reducir la carga administrativa y dedicar más tiempo a los pacientes. Desde el copiloto clínico SofIA hasta los agentes de voz y WhatsApp MarIA, integramos la IA en los sistemas y procesos que los profesionales ya utilizan.  Buscamos un/a Customer Success Manager basado/a en Madrid que acompañe a nuestros clientes, construya relaciones de confianza con los profesionales sanitarios y convierta su experiencia diaria en mejoras de producto.      Tu misión:   Conseguir que nuestros clientes incorporen Omniloy a su día a día y obtengan resultados medibles. Serás el vínculo entre médicos, equipos hospitalarios y nuestro equipo de Producto: escucharás, resolverás barreras y darás seguimiento a sus necesidades desde el primer uso hasta la renovación y expansión de cada cuenta.  Este no es un puesto de soporte reactivo. Tendrás contacto diario con médicos y responsabilidad sobre la adopción, la relación con el cliente y la mejora continua de su experiencia.      ¿Qué harás?    Construir una relación cercana y diaria con los médicos: entender cómo trabajan, acompañarlos en el uso de nuestras soluciones y detectar dificultades en su práctica real.  Convertir feedback en mejoras de producto: recoger ejemplos concretos, distinguir dudas de uso de incidencias y nuevas necesidades, y trasladar información clara y accionable a Producto e Ingeniería.  Cerrar el círculo con los usuarios: hacer seguimiento de los temas abiertos, comunicar avances y coordinar pruebas para comprobar que las mejoras resuelven sus necesidades.  Liderar el onboarding y la adopción: coordinar el arranque con los equipos técnicos, formar a usuarios y acompañar las primeras semanas de uso, tanto presencialmente como a distancia.  Gestionar tu cartera de clientes: mantener relaciones con dirección médica, operaciones, innovación y sistemas, con objetivos, responsables y próximos pasos claros.  Analizar el uso y demostrar valor: detectar caídas de actividad, identificar referentes internos e impulsar acciones para mejorar la adopción. Presentar resultados con indicadores acordados con cada cliente.  Impulsar la retención y el crecimiento: anticipar riesgos, preparar renovaciones e identificar oportunidades de incorporar nuevos usuarios, centros o soluciones junto con Ventas.  Construir procesos que escalen: desarrollar materiales de formación, documentación y buenas prácticas para mejorar la experiencia de cada nuevo cliente.       ¿Qué buscamos?    1 año o más de experiencia en Customer Success, implantación o gestión de clientes B2B, preferiblemente en SaaS o tecnología sanitaria.  Capacidad para generar confianza con médicos y equipos hospitalarios, escuchar con atención y explicar tecnología de forma sencilla.  Excelente comunicación oral y escrita: sabes gestionar expectativas y mantener a cada interlocutor informado.  Organización y constancia para gestionar varios clientes y dar seguimi

title: Customer Success Manager (SaaS)
location: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
description: Customer Success [Coach Terminator]       Sobre nosotros y nuestra cultura [The Walcu Way]:   Somos una start-up tecnológica que ofrece un CRM (herramienta de gestión comercial) en la nube (SaaS) a concesionarios. En 8 años ya somos unos 50 empleados y facturamos €8M anuales en ventas de software a empresas del automóvil. Nos hemos convertido en líderes del mercado español y ya tenemos presencia en otros países de Europa y Latinoamérica.      Sobre ti:   No seremos nosotros quienes digamos cómo eres tú, salvo en este caso, que sí lo haremos. 🙂   Tú tienes experiencia o quieres desarrollarte en la gestión de clientes y entorno SaaS.  Tienes una escritura excelente y unas habilidades comunicativas poderosas –¿lleva coma el vocativo?–, y te sientes muy cómodo/a trabajando en un ambiente eléctrico y de alto rendimiento..  Eres una persona con una alta inteligencia emocional y con la capacidad de entender y empatizar con las necesidades de otros.  Eres una persona curiosa con criterio para detectar mejoras en la experiencia del usuario, te manejas bien con la tecnología, tienes iniciativa y proactividad. Esto es importante para encajar bien con nuestra cultura, ya que somos doers.  Te llena de energía hacer que tus clientes consigan hacer realidad sus proyectos.  Quieres ser la persona que ayuda a nuestros clientes a sacar el máximo partido de nuestro software.       ¿Cómo será tu día a día como Customer Coach?   Sí, hemos retirado el término Customer Success y lo hemos rebrandeado como Customer Coach porque el verdadero éxito no consiste en ayudar a los clientes a hacer el trabajo. Se trata de ayudarles a aprender a hacer el trabajo. No hacemos el trabajo para los clientes.  Enseñamos a los clientes a hacer el trabajo por sí mismos.      Responsabilidades principales:    Llevarás cuentas del mercado Español.  Liderarás la cuenta una vez finalizado el onboarding, siendo la persona de referencia del cliente en su día a día.  Entrenarás y acompañarás al cliente para que saque el máximo partido a Walcu y lo integre en su operativa real.  Entenderás su negocio, sus objetivos y sus retos para convertir la herramienta en impacto tangible.  Identificarás oportunidades de evolución en la cuenta, proponiendo ampliaciones que generen impacto real. Para nosotros el éxito no es vender más licencias, sino que el cliente sienta Walcu como su propio CRM.  Monitorizarás la salud de la relación (uso, engagement, riesgo de churn) y actuarás antes de que haya problemas.  Trasladarás al equipo de Producto feedback accionable y defenderás la voz del cliente dentro de Walcu.       Condiciones laborales:    Contrato a jornada completa –40 horas semanales–.  Contrato indefinido –queremos a alguien para siempre ❤–.  Palomitas de mantequilla y happydent de menta ilimitados.  Y alucina vecina:ni UNO ni DOS sino TRES microondas. title: Customer Success Manager, UK
description: Ciao, we're TextYess 👋   We're the AI-first CRM that turns conversations into revenue. On-site, WhatsApp, email, voice: our AI Agents sell, support, and retain customers for the best B2C brands out there, autonomously.  We believe the future of commerce is warmer, more human than ever - just at a scale no human team could pull off alone.  We've raised €7M+ and work with brands like Ducati, Pittarosso, MC2 Saint Barth, and Doppelgänger. We're a lean, fast, Italian-born scale-up now expanding our story internationally and this role is a big part of writing it.   The role   We're looking for our first  Customer Success Manager dedicated to the UK market : a bilingual English–Italian marketer with agency-side experience who can take over live accounts from day one. You'll  own a portfolio of UK merchants end to end , from onboarding to expansion, carry a  revenue number on your book from month 3 , and give our UK merchants a native-speaking partner as the market scales.   What You'll Actually Be Doing     Run your UK book end to end, from the handover from Sales through onboarding, adoption and retention, keeping Attio current as the source of truth.   Run migrations onto TextYess from Klaviyo, Shopify Email, Brevo and Omnisend: domains, consent, templates and all.   Build and launch WhatsApp and email campaigns and automations together with merchants, then teach them to run them on their own.   Grow revenue by spotting and closing upsells: plan upgrades, new channels, Autonomous CRM.   Create the bridge between the UK and the team: be the voice of UK merchants with Product and Sales, and see technical issues through to resolution with our platform team, Meta and 360dialog.      What You Bring     Experience in Customer Success, Account Management or a client-facing role, with hands-on experience running email or CRM campaigns for e-commerce clients (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Brevo, Omnisend or Shopify Email). Agency background strongly preferred: here you do the marketing work with the merchant, not just manage the relationship.   You're at home in Shopify and DTC e-commerce, and can turn ROAS and attributed revenue into a commercial case.   A track record managing a client portfolio, including renewal and upsell conversations.   English native or fully bilingual (C2) and Italian at C1 or above, both mandatory.   Nice to have: experience with WhatsApp marketing or conversational commerce, a migration between marketing platforms under your belt, or a network in UK e-commerce.      Why TextYess     Real ownership, from day one. No layers, no waiting your turn: you'll own outcomes, not just tasks.   Lean team, big impact. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with top-notch international talent, ready to disrupt and leave a mark.   Build, don't maintain. We're early enough that most of what you touch doesn't have a playbook yet, you get to write it.   Grow as fast as you push. Roles and responsibilities scale with what you prove you can do, not with tenure.

title: Kontaktcenterchef
description: Vill du leda ett team genom en av de största förändringsresorna inom svensk hörselvård?   På Audika hjälper vi människor att höra livets viktiga ögonblick. Varje dag möter vi kunder som vill återfå möjligheten att delta i samtal, vara nära sina familjer och leva livet fullt ut.  Nu söker vi en Kontaktcenterchef som vill vara med och skriva nästa kapitel i vår historia.  Vi befinner oss i en historisk utveckling där hörselvården förändras och där vi behöver kombinera det bästa av två världar: högkvalitativ hörselvård och ett tydligt kommersiellt fokus. För oss handlar kommersialitet inte om att sälja mer för sakens skull. Det handlar om att nå fler människor som behöver vår hjälp, skapa en hållbar verksamhet och göra skillnad för ännu fler kunder.  Därför söker vi en ledare som trivs med och motiveras av att driva förändring, vågar utmana invanda arbetssätt och skapar engagemang, ansvarstagande och resultat.  Vi söker inte en chef som leder från sidlinjen. Vi söker en ledare som är närvarande, nyfiken och som leder genom att själv vara en del av verksamheten.   Om rollen   Som Kontaktcenterchef har du det övergripande ansvaret för vårt kontaktcenter med 15 medarbetare och det resultat som skapas.  Kontaktcentret är en viktig del av kundresan och ofta den första kontakten med Audika.  Teamet hjälper kunder att ta första steget mot bättre hörsel genom rådgivning, vägledning och bokning av hörselundersökningar på våra kliniker runt om i Sverige.  Du ansvarar för verksamhet, medarbetare, kvalitet och resultat. Samtidigt är du en närvarande ledare som arbetar nära den dagliga verksamheten. Du coachar, följer upp, utvecklar och skapar förutsättningar för att teamet ska lyckas.  Det här är en roll för dig som tror på att leda genom exempel. Du sitter inte vid sidan av verksamheten. Du är en del av den. Du medlyssnar, analyserar kunddialoger, ger konkret feedback och kliver vid behov själv in för att förstå, stötta och utveckla verksamheten.  Du rapporterar till Marknadschef och samarbetar tätt med flera funktioner inom organisationen.   Du kommer bland annat att:      Leda, coacha och utveckla teamet mot högt ställda mål.  Skapa en kultur präglad av ansvarstagande, samarbete och engagemang.  Driva förändringsarbete och utveckla arbetssätt som stärker både kundupplevelse och resultat.  Säkerställa hög kvalitet i kunddialoger genom uppföljning, medlyssning och coaching.  Arbeta aktivt med kompetensutveckling och prestationsledning.  Följa upp och analysera KPI:er samt omsätta insikter till konkreta aktiviteter.  Säkerställa rätt bemanning, rekrytering och introduktion av nya medarbetare.  Arbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå kundernas behov och teamets vardag.  Bidra till att utveckla Audikas kommersiella förmåga på ett sätt som går hand i hand med vårt uppdrag inom hörselvården.       Vi söker en ledare som vågar göra skillnad   Vi tror att du är en trygg, modig och närvarande ledare som får energi av att utveckla människor och verksamheter.  Du vet

title: Senior Software Engineer (Trust)
description:
Beneath a simple yet elegant user interface lies a complex system of functionalities. Our AI-powered product uses advanced image recognition, facial verification, face recognition, facial anti-spoofing (liveness detection), and behavior analysis to make identity decisions. We help our partners build onboarding processes that ensure good people get things done and bad folks get stopped.

But knowing who someone is only gets you halfway. The next question is whether they can be trusted — and answering it means checking a person's identity data against the authoritative sources that hold the truth. Every country does this differently: a different registry, a different database, a different set of rules about what can be checked and how.

To take our platform to the next level, we're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Trust team. This team builds and operates the services that validate a person's identity data against country-specific authoritative sources — government registries, national databases, AML and sanctions screening — and turns that patchwork of very different upstreams into a single, dependable trust signal our customers can act on. Alongside sibling teams like Trust Registries and Trusted Documents, your work directly determines how many countries we can cover, how fast we can launch a new one, and how much our partners can rely on the answer we give them.

YOU'LL HELP US PROTECT HONEST PEOPLE ONLINE BY:

  • Designing, building, and operating Trust's backend services — the integrations with external identity data sources and the validation logic on top of them — with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, and maintainability
  • Expanding our global coverage: onboarding new countries and data sources quickly, and building the abstractions that make the next integration cheaper than the last one instead of more expensive
  • Modelling messy, inconsistent upstream data into consistent, well-defined verification results — including the matching and validation rules that decide whether the data actually belongs to the person in front of us
  • Making our systems resilient to upstreams we don't control — timeouts, retries and idempotency, backpressure, circuit breaking, graceful degradation, backwards-compatibility testing, SPOF elimination, and end-to-end monitoring of every provider we depend on
  • Handling sensitive personal data responsibly, with regional data residency and compliance requirements designed in from the start
  • Participating in on-call rotations, incident response, and postmortems to ensure our most critical checks stay healthy
  • Driving engineering quality through code reviews, CI practices, runbook documentation, and mentoring teammates

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly's operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

  • Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
  • Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
  • Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.

title: Account Executive | Automotive - Enterprise SaaS
description:
Intro

Every industrial company on our customer list, ZF, Schaeffler, Miele, Maersk, Lufthansa, is fighting the same challenge: margin erosion from tariffs, CBAM, and supply chains nobody fully understands anymore. We're not another SaaS tool competing for budget. We're the difference between a board that knows its cost exposure and one that finds out the hard way. As Account Executive, you own that conversation end to end, first call to signed contract, for the deals that actually move the needle.

Why this seat is different
The deals are long-cycle, technical, and multi-stakeholder, procurement, sustainability, and operations all in the room, often with conflicting priorities. If you've sold complex B2B SaaS where the win depends on translating technical value into board-level urgency, this is that seat, at a stage early enough that you'll shape how we do it, not just execute a playbook someone else wrote.


Your tasks

  • Own the entire sales cycle: prospecting, qualification, negotiation, close
  • Build and run your own outbound strategy across LinkedIn, phone, email, and your own network
  • Lead demos and presentations that translate technical product value into business urgency for enterprise buyers
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder enterprise deals (procurement, sustainability, technical) without losing momentum
  • Keep your pipeline clean and current in our CRM
  • Partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to keep what we sell aligned with what we can deliver
  • Bring market and competitor intel back to the team to sharpen our positioning


Your profile

title: Junior-Finanzberater (w/m/d), selbstständig, auch nebenberuflich
description:
Du willst Finanzberatung nicht aus dem Lehrbuch lernen, sondern dort, wo sie passiert? Bei Old Fox Finance steigst du in die ganzheitliche Finanz- und Versicherungsberatung ein. Vom ersten Tag an begleitest du erfahrene Berater bei echten Kundenterminen, meist online und siehst live, wie aus Zahlen ein Finanzkonzept wird, das zum Leben eines Menschen passt.

Du arbeitest selbstständig, aber nicht allein: Erfahrene Partner stehen dir zur Seite und die Abwicklung von Anträgen und Verträgen läuft über einen Maklerpool. Um IT und Papierkram musst du dich nicht kümmern. Produkt- und Absatzvorgaben gibt es keine.

Aufgaben

  • Von Anfang an mittendrin: Du begleitest erfahrene Berater bei Kundenterminen und lernst Gesprächsführung, Bedarfsanalyse und Finanzplanung in der Praxis.

  • Dein eigener Kundenkreis: Schritt für Schritt baust du dir eigene Kunden auf.

  • Selbst beraten: Mit der IHK-Sachkundeprüfung und eigener Erlaubnis berätst du deine Kunden später selbst, zu Absicherung, Altersvorsorge, Vermögensaufbau und Finanzierung.

  • Dein Rhythmus: Wann und wo du arbeitest, entscheidest du selbst.Qualifikation

Qualifikation

  • Begeisterung für Finanzen und Vermögensaufbau, gern auch für deine eigenen

  • Freude an Gesprächen und der Wunsch, Menschen wirklich weiterzubringen

  • Eigenmotivation und Durchhaltevermögen: Du ziehst Dinge durch, auch wenn es mal zäh wird

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Von Vorteil: kaufmännische Ausbildung, Studium oder erste Erfahrung in Bank, Versicherung oder Vertrieb

  • Du erfüllst nicht alles, hast aber Lust auf die Herausforderung? Dann melde dich trotzdem.

Benefits

  • Echte Praxis statt Theorie: erfahrene Berater an deiner Seite, ab Tag eins

title: AI Video Editor für Social Ads (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission

Kurz vorab: Wir suchen jemanden, der richtig Lust hat. Auf Tempo, auf Qualität und auf neue Werkzeuge. Wenn du Verantwortung magst, schnell lernst und AI als Chance für deine Kreativität siehst, bist du hier richtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office im Herzen Münchens, weil gute Creatives im Team entstehen und wir zusammen am schnellsten sind.

Du schneidest Video-Ads, die im Feed hängen bleiben, und bringst sie mit Motion zum Leben. AI nutzt du dabei so selbstverständlich wie dein Schnittprogramm: für Bilder, Szenen, Stimmen, Varianten und alles, was dich schneller und besser macht. Du setzt nicht nur um. Du baust auch die Abläufe, mit denen unser Team morgen arbeitet.

Konkret

  • Du schneidest Short-Form-Ads für Meta, TikTok und YouTube: Hooks, Pacing, Sound und Untertitel.
  • Du baust aus einem Konzept viele Varianten, schnell und sauber.
  • Du animierst Typo, Produkte und Übergänge in After Effects.
  • Du setzt AI-Tools im Schnitt und in der Animation ein und probierst laufend neue aus.
  • Du entwickelst eigene Workflows, hältst sie fest und zeigst sie dem Team.
  • Du siehst die Zahlen deiner Ads und lernst daraus, was funktioniert.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Videoschnitt, am besten mit Short Form oder Social Ads.
  • Du bist schnell und sicher in Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve und in After Effects.
  • Du arbeitest bereits mit AI-Tools für Video, Bild oder Ton und kannst zeigen, was du damit gemacht hast.
  • Du hast ein Gespür für Hooks, Timing und Rhythmus.
  • Du willst wissen, warum eine Ad funktioniert, und nicht nur, ob sie gut aussieht.
  • Du nimmst Feedback an, gibst selbst welches und lieferst zuverlässig.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse.
  • Du wohnst in München oder ziehst für den Job her. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam im Office.

title: Mobile Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

Business Development Manager – Street

📍 Manchester (hybrid, up to 2 days WFH)
💰 £35k basic - £65k OTE

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everyone buying, selling, renting and letting property, improving the industry for all of them by elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.

If you join us, you'll be helping to improve the property industry for everyone by widening the reach of our products and introducing them to estate agents across the UK, in turn making agents more successful and helping them deliver an incredible customer experience. We'll support you with structured training, a competitive commission structure and an open, inclusive environment.

If you love autonomy, are naturally curious and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you'd fit right in!

  • Building and managing a pipeline of potential clients, focusing on high-value opportunities.

  • Using a consultative sales approach to deliver Street demos that address each client's specific needs.

  • Proactively sourcing and nurturing leads to grow your pipeline and secure new business opportunities.

  • Ensuring a seamless handover to, and close collaboration with, our Customer Success team, to increase client ROI and reduce churn.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Geleitet von den Werten Würde, Wohlstand, Demokratie und Nachhaltigkeit suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – idealerweise ab dem 1. Januar – für unser Energy Lab eine Person als (Senior) Economist für Energiemärkte. 

In dieser Position konzipierst Du Analysen und Studien zu Energiemärkten – insbesondere zum Strommarkt – und führst sie eigenständig durch. Dabei betrachtest Du Energiekosten, Investitionsbedarfe, Gesamtsystemkosten sowie die Wechselwirkungen politischer Instrumente mit diesen Größen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen die Fragen, wie sich Energiepolitik mit Wettbewerbsfähigkeit, Nachhaltigkeit und Bezahlbarkeit zusammendenken lässt, wie Energiekosten strategisch und gezielt gesenkt werden können, und wie das regulatorische Umfeld so ausgestaltet werden kann, dass es den Erfolg der „zweiten Hälfte der Energiewende“ und damit die Erreichung der Klimaneutralität ermöglicht.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform
description:
The Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform is responsible for building, running, and evolving the ML monorepo used by the X-ray, CT, and MRI machine learning group at DeepHealth. The monorepo covers the full path from experimentation to product: dataset and sample definitions, training and evaluation code, experiment tracking, model export, and the inference servers that run in production. Everyone on the team contributes to the monorepo; this role is the single point of accountability for it. This hands-on role owns the architecture, tooling, and engineering standards of that codebase for a distributed team of about twenty machine learning engineers and scientists, working with model developers and software engineers to make the team’s work fast, better, and easier to audit. It also leads the team's agentic coding strategy, shaping how AI coding agents are used across the codebase. The role reports to the Leader of the ML for X-ray/CT/MRI group.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities  

  • Own the architecture and roadmap of the ML Monorepo:

    • Module boundaries, shared abstractions for datasets and samples, training and evaluation loops, configuration, and experiment tracking.

  • Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase:

    • Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure.

title: Senior interim manager in de zorg in loondienst
description:
Ben jij een ervaren leider die energie krijgt van het aanbrengen van structuur in uitdagende situaties? Hou je ervan om orde op zaken te stellen en daarna door te gaan naar de volgende interne opdracht?
